title: Detail-oriented Bookkeeper – Full-Time | Remote | AU
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll. 

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation. 

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

title: Startup Operations & Growth Manager — E-Commerce
description:
This is a Long-Term Opportunity



About the Role:



I am building a new U.S.-based science/biotechnology e-commerce company and am looking for a highly organized, resourceful Startup Operations & Growth Manager to work directly with me as we move from development through launch and growth.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant role and is not simply a social media position.

I am looking for someone who can help manage the moving pieces involved in launching a new company, coordinate with outside vendors and service providers, keep projects and deadlines moving, help establish organized systems and processes, and support the company's e-commerce and marketing growth.

Several professional firms and vendors are already involved in building different parts of the business. Your role will be to help manage execution and follow-through—making sure responsibilities are tracked, deadlines aren't missed, and projects continue moving forward.

As you learn the business, I want you to become increasingly independent and take ownership of areas that no longer require my day-to-day involvement.



What You'll Help Manage:



Operations & Project Management

- Track projects, deadlines, deliverables and outstanding items

- Coordinate and follow up with vendors, contractors and service providers

- Maintain organized project trackers and company documentation

- Identify delays, bottlenecks and missing information

- Help develop SOPs, checklists and repeatable processes

- Manage follow-ups, priorities and recurring operational responsibilities

- Provide clear progress updates and identify anything requiring founder involvement



E-Commerce & Growth

- Assist with Shopify or WordPress website management

- Coordinate website and product updates

- Help improve customer journeys and conversion opportunities

- Support
 marketing and automated flows

- Research competitors, affiliates, influencers and growth opportunities

- Assist with SEO, content and customer-acquisition initiatives



Marketing & Social Media

- Help establish and grow Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube

- Develop and maintain a content calendar

- Create graphics and short-form content using Canva, CapCut or similar tools

- Research trends and successful competitor content

- Track engagement, traffic and growth

- Bring ideas and recommendations instead of waiting for daily instructions



Who I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate is:

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Proactive and comfortable working independently

- Strong at follow-through and holding projects accountable

- Comfortable managing multiple projects at once

- A strong researcher and problem-solver

- Able to communicate professionally in written and spoken English

- Comfortable working directly with a founder

- Interested in building systems and improving processes

- Comfortable learning new software and tools

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

-Whether you have called U.S. homeowners before.

“Hey John, this is Mia with Everlast Roofing & Restoration. I’m reaching out because we’ve been working with a few homeowners in your area after the recent hailstorms. I just wanted to see if anybody has taken a look at your roof yet for possible storm damage?”

A homeowner says, “I’m not interested. My roof is fine.” What would you say next?

title: JOB TITLE: Full-Time Real Estate Cold Caller and Lead Intake VA
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



Pilgrim Property Group is a growing real estate investment company located in Georgia, USA. We purchase properties directly from homeowners and are looking for a dependable, confident, and motivated virtual assistant to join us long-term.



POSITION DETAILS



• Full-time position

• Monday through Friday

• 9:30 a.m.–6:30 p.m. Eastern Time

• One-hour unpaid lunch

• 40 paid hours per week

• Starting pay: $5 USD per hour

• Bonus: $100 for every deal we successfully close from your leads

• Long-term opportunity with room to grow



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Cold-call property owners from lists we provide

• Ask homeowners whether they would consider selling

• Follow our calling script and qualification process

• Gather basic information about the seller and property

• Identify motivation, condition, asking price, and timeline

• Enter accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

• Schedule callbacks and follow-up appointments

• Immediately notify Grant about motivated sellers

• Properly handle Do Not Call and opt-out requests

• Submit a simple end-of-day performance report



REQUIREMENTS



• Strong and understandable spoken English

• Confident, friendly, and professional phone presence

• Previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

• Real estate cold-calling experience is strongly preferred

• Comfortable handling objections and upset homeowners

• Reliable computer, headset, and high-speed internet

• Backup internet and power plan

• Quiet and professional working environment

• Able to work the complete Eastern Time schedule

• Dependable, coachable, honest, and detail-oriented

• Able to follow instructions and consistently update the CRM



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “PILGRIM” so I know you read the entire job post.



Please include:



Your name and location.



A résumé or summary of your work experience.



Your real estate and cold-calling experience.



The dialers and CRMs you have used.



Your internet speed and computer specifications.



Details about your backup internet and power.



Confirmation that you can work Monday through Friday from 9:30 a.m.–6:30 p.m. Eastern Time.



Why you left your most recent job.



How you would respond if a homeowner became angry and asked you to stop calling.



A link to a 60–90 second voice recording.



In your voice recording:



• Introduce yourself and explain why you would be good for this position.

• Read the following practice cold-call opener:



“Hi, this is [Your Name] with Pilgrim Property Group. I’m reaching out about your property at [address]. I wanted to see if you would ever consider selling it if we could make you a fair cash offer and purchase it as-is?”



Applications without a voice recording or the word “PILGRIM” will not be considered.



Selected candidates will complete a video interview, cold-call role-play, and short paid trial before receiving a permanent position.

title: Outbound Sales Manager
description:
Remote | U.S. Central Time**



Upkeep Standard is a growing residential cleaning company serving Northwest Chicagoland. We are building a remote sales team focused on converting leads into recurring biweekly and monthly cleaning clients.



We are hiring a Sales Manager based in the Philippines to take ownership of the day-to-day sales operation.



This is not just a senior caller position. You will manage the sales team, monitor performance, coach callers, manage the pipeline, and make sure leads are consistently followed through.



The goal of this role is to build a sales team that can operate successfully without the owner managing it every day.



What You Will Own



Sales Team Management

- Manage the daily activity of our sales callers

- Lead team check-ins and performance conversations

- Monitor attendance, activity, follow-up, and results

- Answer routine sales-team questions

- Hold callers accountable to expectations

- Help onboard and train new sales team members

- Address performance issues before they become larger problems



Coaching and Call Quality

- Review calls and customer interactions

- Coach callers on scripts, tone, objection handling, and closing

- Conduct role-play and practice sessions

- Identify individual coaching needs

- Make sure the team follows Upkeep Standard messaging and policies



Lead and Pipeline Management

- Ensure all leads are contacted and followed up appropriately

- Monitor lead status and next actions

- Prevent leads from being forgotten or left untouched

- Make sure quotes and follow-ups happen on time

- Reassign leads when needed

- Identify where leads are being lost in the sales process



Performance Tracking



You will track and manage performance including:

- Calls made

- Contacts reached

- Follow-ups completed

- Qualified leads

- Quotes generated

- Recurring clients booked

- Individual conversion rates

- Team conversion rate

- Revenue and recurring revenue generated



You should be able to explain what the numbers mean and what the team needs to do differently when results are below goal.



Owner Reporting



The Sales Manager will provide the owner with a concise weekly sales update covering:

- Team results

- New recurring clients

- Pipeline health

- Individual caller performance

- Problems or risks

- Recommended actions



The owner should not need to manage routine caller questions, daily follow-up, call coaching, or basic performance issues.



You are expected to take ownership and escalate only issues that require owner-level decisions.



Decision-Making Authority



Within established company policies, the Sales Manager will be expected to:

- Assign leads

- Manage caller schedules and workflow

- Conduct coaching

- Require additional training

- Set follow-up expectations

- Address attendance and performance issues

- Recommend hiring, additional hours, reduced hours, or termination when appropriate

- Recommend changes to scripts and sales processes based on performance data



Major pricing, compensation, company policy, and strategic decisions remain with ownership.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Sales Manager will create a team where:

- Leads are consistently worked

- Follow-ups happen without reminders from the owner

- Caller performance is measured

- Weak performance is addressed quickly

- Strong performers receive coaching to improve further

- New callers can be onboarded efficiently

- Sales activity is organized and visible

- The owner can review results instead of managing daily activity



Qualifications



We are looking for someone with:

- Sales team leadership, supervisor, or management experience

- Experience managing telesales, appointment setters, outbound callers, or customer acquisition teams

- Strong spoken and written English

- Confidence coaching and giving direct feedback

- Strong organization and follow-through

- Experience using a CRM or lead-management system

- Comfort using spreadsheets, call systems, messaging platforms, and performance dashboards

- Reliable computer, headset, and internet connection

- Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time hours



Experience in home services, cleaning services, appointment setting, call centers, or recurring-service businesses is helpful but not required.



Who Will Do Well in This Role



We want someone who naturally asks:

- Are all leads being worked?

- Are follow-ups happening?

- Who is converting?

- Who needs coaching?

- Where are we losing customers?

- What needs to improve this week?



You should be comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and managing people without waiting for the owner to provide instructions for every situation.



Schedule

-Remote position based in the Philippines.

-You must be available during agreed U.S. Central Time hours to manage the sales team while they are actively working.

-Weekly hours and final schedule will be discussed during the interview.



Compensation

-Compensation will be based on experience and leadership responsibilities.



The position may include:

- Base hourly or monthly compensation

- Performance incentives based on team results

- Opportunities for additional responsibility as Upkeep Standard grows



How to Apply



Please apply to posting and submit:

- Resume

- Desired hourly or monthly rate

- Availability in U.S. Central Time

- Number of salespeople you have previously managed

- Brief description of your sales-management experience



Please also answer:

1. You inherit a team of four sales callers. What are the first five things you would review before d
 what needs to change?



We are looking for someone who can own the sales operation, lead people, improve results, and reduce the owner's involvement in daily sales management.

title: Video Editor – Performance Ads / E-commerce
description:
Freeflo Club is a rapidly growing Australian e-commerce brand creating reusable ice products for fishing, boating, camping and everyday use.



We’re looking for an experienced and highly meticulous video editor to join us on an ongoing basis and help us produce a consistent stream of high-performing paid social ads every week.



We already have an editing style that works well, and we need someone who can closely match that style, understand what makes it work, and continue building on it over time.



This is not a role for someone who relies on crazy effects, over-the-top transitions or overly complicated editing. Our style is simple, professional, fast-paced and constantly engaging. We want the footage, product and message to do the heavy lifting.

Our products are also very visual and relatively easy to create strong ads around, so the right editor will have a lot to work with.



How the process will work

We have a growing network of fishing and outdoor creators who are constantly providing us with content.

On top of that, we:

- Shoot raw clips ourselves

- Regularly receive influencer and UGC content

- Have access to professional video shoots and imagery

- Maintain a large shared content library



All of this content will be available to you through a shared drive, so there will be no shortage of footage to work with.

For most ads, we will provide you with a completed recorded voiceover.

Your job will then be to turn that voiceover into a highly engaging advertisement by:

- Matching each section of the voiceover with the most relevant footage

- Finding the strongest clips from our content library

- Keeping the edit fast-paced with minimal downtime

- Adding clean and easy-to-read captions

- Adding supporting text where appropriate

- Selecting suitable background music

- Keeping the viewer engaged throughout the entire video

- Creating a strong opening hook

- Maintaining our existing editing style while looking for ways to improve it



We particularly like music that suits an Australian fishing, boating and outdoor audience. We’ll provide examples of the types of songs and sounds that suit the Freeflo brand, but over time we expect you to develop a strong understanding of what works.



Weekly workflow

Ideally, we are looking for someone who can consistently produce:

5 video ads every single week



Our normal workflow will be:

Monday: 5 completed video ads submitted for review

Monday: We review each video and provide detailed feedback

Tuesday: Revisions completed and final videos uploaded



We believe strongly in giving clear and detailed feedback.

We want our editor to understand exactly what we like, what we don’t like and why. The goal is to get on the same page quickly so that, over time, you understand the Freeflo style extremely well and fewer revisions are required.

Attention to detail is very important to us.



What we are looking for

We are extremely particular about our creative and are only looking for experienced applicants.

You should have:

- Strong experience editing short-form advertisements

- Excellent attention to detail

- A very good understanding of pacing and viewer retention

- Experience with paid social or e-commerce creative

- Excellent ability to match visuals with a voiceover

- Strong judgement when selecting footage

- Good understanding of captions and on-screen text

- Ability to find music that suits the brand and audience

- Ability to closely follow an established editing style

- Reliable weekly turnaround

- Strong organisation when working from a large content library

- Ability to take detailed feedback and implement it properly



We do not want excessive effects, flashy transitions or over-produced editing.

Our strongest ads feel authentic, exciting, polished and fast-moving while still keeping things simple.

Editing style and creative judgement are extremely important to us. In many ways, you either have the eye for this style or you don’t, so please only apply if you genuinely believe your experience and portfolio are a strong fit.

We are very selective and are only interested in experienced applicants.



Salary and performance bonuses

Salary will be negotiated based on experience, skill level and the quality of your portfolio.

In addition to your regular salary, we will also offer performance bonuses for high-performing advertisements when agreed ROAS targets are achieved.

We want the person creating our ads to feel invested in the results they help produce.

We believe in investing in good people and keeping our team motivated.

If you do well for us, we will look after you.

As Freeflo continues to grow, there will also be opportunities for the role, responsibilities and compensation to grow with it.



Application process

When applying, please send us:

- Your portfolio

- Your 3 best short-form advertisements

- The editing software you use

- Your expected hourly or monthly rate

- Your availability

- A brief explanation of why you think your editing style would suit Freeflo Club



We would much rather review 3 excellent ads than a folder containing 50 average edits.

Shortlisted applicants will also be asked to create a Freeflo ad before we make our final hiring decision.

We will provide you with the footage, voiceover and brief so we can assess your pacing, clip selection, captions, music choice, attention to detail and overall creative judgement using the exact type of work you would be doing with us.

We are looking for someone we can work with long-term, so finding the right person is much more important to us than filling the position quickly.



If you think your editing style is a strong fit, we’d love to see your work.

title: Gaming Shorts Editor / VOD Clipper for YouTube + Twitch
description:
Gaming Shorts Editor / VOD Clipper for YouTube + Twitch



I’m looking for a video editor to help turn my existing gaming content into YouTube Shorts and other short-form vertical content.



I run a gaming YouTube/Twitch channel focused primarily on FPS games such as Battlefield 6 and WARDOGS.



The most important part of this role



I need someone who is comfortable watching through my published stream VODs and long-form YouTube videos and identifying the strongest moments themselves.



I do not want to provide timestamps for every Short.



You should be able to recognise moments that could work well as short-form content, including:



* High-skill or impressive gameplay

* Clutches / kill streaks

* Funny or unexpected moments

* Useful tips or educational moments

* Strong reactions

* Interesting commentary

* Moments that can tell a complete mini-story within 20–60 seconds



What you’ll be doing



* Watch existing YouTube videos and stream VODs

* Identify clips with strong Shorts potential

* Edit selected moments into 9:16 vertical videos

* Create a strong hook within the first 1–2 seconds

* Reframe gameplay appropriately for mobile

* Add clean, readable captions where appropriate

* Use zooms, sound effects, music and graphics only when they improve the clip

* Maintain good pacing and viewer retention

* Export finished Shorts ready to upload



Editing style



I’m looking for clean, polished editing.



I do not want every clip filled with unnecessary memes, constant zooms, excessive sound effects or hyperactive TikTok-style editing.



The gameplay and moment should remain the focus.



A strong understanding of gaming/FPS content is highly preferred. If you actively play games or have previously edited gaming creators, please mention this in your application.



Trial



I would like to begin with a small paid trial of 3 Shorts.



For the trial, I’ll provide access to existing published content and I want you to choose the moments yourself.



If the trial goes well, I’m looking for someone who can work with me on an ongoing basis and regularly produce Shorts from new videos and streams.



When applying



Please include:



1. Examples of gaming Shorts or gaming videos you have personally edited.

2. What games you play or are familiar with.

3. Whether you are comfortable watching full VODs and selecting clips without timestamps.

4. Your expected rate for an ongoing arrangement.

5. What you would charge for an initial trial of 3 Shorts.



Please start your application with the word FUZZY so I know you actually read the job description.



I’m more interested in finding someone who understands good content and clip selection than simply finding the cheapest editor.

title: Junior Video Editor - Technical Video and Real Film Work
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, first responder, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace, defense, and first responder are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Dedicated Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.



***On your portfolio: Send me real work, not volume. Do not send a reel, a montage, or a folder with fifty UGC ads, TikToks, and social cuts in it. A montage tells me nothing about whether you can structure a piece. I want links to complete finished videos, with the runtime stated, and a one-line note on what you were responsible for on each.



If you do not have long-form finished work, say so directly in your application. That is a fair answer and it will not get you thrown out. Padding the link with short-form to make the portfolio look full will.***



- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Adobe InDesign Catalog Layout Specialist – Jewelry & Wellness
description:
VITALIX is a European jewelry and wellness brand. We are looking for a reliable Adobe InDesign specialist to help us update and expand our product catalog.



This role focuses on accurately reproducing and adapting existing layouts. We provide the visual direction, reference pages, product images, text and product information. Your job is to turn these materials into polished, consistent catalog pages, with careful attention to typography and detail.



THE WORK



• Recreate catalog pages in Adobe InDesign using supplied layouts and references.

• Add new pages and product sections that match the existing catalog.

• Place and format supplied text, including headlines, descriptions, prices, product codes and captions.

• Arrange product and lifestyle images with appropriate cropping, proportions and consistent product sizing.

• Update existing pages and implement feedback accurately.

• Prepare German and French versions using supplied text.

• Deliver fully editable InDesign files and correctly prepared PDFs for review and printing.



WHAT MATTERS TO US



We need someone who notices the small details that make a catalog look professional and make products easy to understand.



Please pay particular attention to:



• Consistent fonts, font sizes, line spacing and paragraph formatting.

• Clean alignment, balanced spacing, margins and page grids.

• Clear relationships between each product, its image, description, price and product code.

• Readable text and a clear visual hierarchy.

• Consistent layouts across individual pages and facing-page spreads.

• Correct image proportions and cropping.

• Accurate placement of supplied text, including accents and special characters.

• Text overflow, awkward line breaks and missing content.

• Page numbering and consistency after pages are added or moved.

• Print requirements, including bleed, image resolution, color settings and the printer’s PDF specifications.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong practical Adobe InDesign skills.

• Experience working on product catalogs, brochures or other multi-page print publications.

• A good eye for typography, spacing and composition.

• The ability to follow an existing design closely and apply it consistently.

• Confident use of paragraph styles, character styles and parent pages.

• The ability to maintain organized, editable files with properly linked images.

• Reliable communication in English.

• Careful self-checking before submitting work.



Basic Photoshop skills for image preparation would be helpful.



German or French language skills are a bonus. We provide the final text; translation and copywriting are separate from this role. You should preserve the supplied wording and flag anything unclear before making changes.



HOW WE WILL WORK TOGETHER



We will start with a small paid trial, such as one double-page spread, using our materials and a reference layout.



If the work is a good fit, we would like to continue with additional catalog pages and regular updates. The workload will vary depending on the current project. Please tell us your weekly availability and typical turnaround time.



DELIVERABLES



• Editable Adobe InDesign source files (.indd).

• An IDML file for compatibility.

• A packaged project with linked images and fonts where licensing permits.

• A PDF for review.

• A print-ready PDF following the supplied printer specifications.



Before delivery, please run InDesign’s preflight checks and resolve missing links, missing fonts and overset text.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Two or three relevant examples of catalogs or multi-page publications you personally worked on.

2. A short explanation of your contribution to those examples.

3. Your experience with Adobe InDesign and the version you use.

4. Your hourly rate and whether you also offer fixed pricing per page or double-page spread.

5. Your weekly availability and earliest start date.

6. Confirmation that you are available for a small paid trial.



Please start your application with “VITALIX Catalog” so we can easily identify applications that address this brief.



We value accurate execution, a good eye for detail and dependable communication. We are looking for someone who can follow a clear reference, check their own work and help us produce a beautiful, consistent catalog.

title: Amazon FBA Product Sourcing VA – Online Arbitrage & Wholesale
description:
We're an active Amazon FBA seller looking for an experienced product researcher to help us identify profitable opportunities through both **Online/Retail Arbitrage and Wholesale sourcing**.



This is a research and lead-generation role only. You will not purchase inventory or handle company funds. We make all final buying decisions and execute all orders ourselves.



You'll work from a defined sourcing scorecard that we provide. This is **not an entry-level position**, and we are not looking to train someone from scratch. We want someone who already understands Amazon product research and can independently identify strong opportunities.



### Responsibilities



- Source profitable products through **Online/Retail Arbitrage** from retailers such as Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Walgreens, and other stores we assign.

- Research **wholesale opportunities** by finding legitimate suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and brands with products that can be profitably resold on Amazon.

- Identify potential wholesale suppliers and provide their website, contact information, product catalogs or price lists when available.

- Use **Keepa and SellerAmp SAS** to evaluate products before submitting them.

- Evaluate every opportunity based on our scorecard, including:

  - Profit and margin

  - ROI

  - Sales rank / BSR

  - Estimated sales velocity

  - Competition and seller count

  - Amazon presence on the listing

  - Buy Box stability

  - Gating restrictions

  - IP / brand complaint risk

- Submit qualifying opportunities with direct product and supplier links along with all supporting research.

- Track leads in our shared Google Sheets system.

- Flag gated brands, restricted categories, suspicious suppliers, and known IP-risk brands before submitting.

- Avoid submitting weak or borderline leads simply to meet a quota. We value **quality over quantity**.



### Requirements



- Prior hands-on experience sourcing products for Amazon FBA.

- Experience with **Online Arbitrage / Retail Arbitrage**.

- **Wholesale sourcing experience is strongly preferred**, including experience finding distributors, wholesalers, supplier catalogs, or direct brand accounts.

- Proficiency with **Keepa and SellerAmp SAS**.

- Strong understanding of:

  - BSR and sales velocity

  - Buy Box behavior

  - Competition

  - ROI and profit calculations

  - Gating

  - IP complaint risk

  - Amazon as a seller

- Ability to recognize legitimate wholesale suppliers versus questionable or unreliable websites.

- Strong attention to detail. We make purchasing decisions based on your research, so inaccurate numbers or incomplete research are unacceptable.

- Reliable internet connection.

- Comfortable working in Google Sheets.

- Available for regular check-ins and communication with our team.



### Pay & Hours



Starting pay is **$3/hour**.



There will be a **two-week trial period** before long-term hiring so we can evaluate the quality, consistency, and accuracy of your sourcing.



There is opportunity for continued work and increased responsibility for researchers who consistently bring us profitable products and strong supplier opportunities.



### How to Apply



Put **"DEAL HUNTER"** as the first words of your reply so we know you read the entire posting.



Please include:



1. **2–3 examples of Amazon leads you have sourced previously**, including why you considered them good opportunities.

2. Tell us whether your experience is primarily **Online Arbitrage, Wholesale, or both**.

3. If you have wholesale experience, briefly explain how you normally find and evaluate new suppliers.

4. Tell us which research tools you currently have access to, including **Keepa, SellerAmp, or any others**.

5. Send a **60-second video introduction** explaining your Amazon sourcing experience.



We are specifically looking for researchers who can find opportunities we would not easily find ourselves. If your experience includes uncovering new wholesale suppliers, distributor accounts, lesser-known retail websites, or consistently profitable Amazon products, make sure to mention that in your application.

title: YouTube Tutorial Video Creator (Short How-To Tutorials)
description:
Hello! Nice to meet you!

We are looking for a YouTube tutorial video creator who can create short, simple step-by-step tutorials.



What We Expect From You:



You must be able to record short, 1-4 minute how-to tutorials without showing your face, only recording the screen and using your own voiceover, narrating the steps and explaining what you’re doing. You will be recording your computer or your phone screen. An example of a video would be “How to delete an Instagram account”.



Here’s exactly what this will look like. I’ll give you the name of the software/tool/app and the exact topic. Then, you do the following:

1. Learn how to use the software/tool/app and how to perform the steps required to record the video (on your own).

2. Record your screen showing the steps required in 1080p Full HD quality, clearly narrating the steps as you go.

3. Do some very basic editing, like cutting mistakes, removing pauses and blurring sensitive information.

4. Upload the finished video file to the provided Google Drive folder.



Fancy editing is NOT NEEDED. Clean recording and clear narration are what matter.



REQUIRED SKILLS:

- Fluent English

- Basic/intermediate computer skills

- The ability to explain what you’re showing on the screen

- You can open a web app/software you have seen for the first time and figure out how it works on your own, either by exploring it yourself, watching videos about it or finding the information online.

- Basic editing skills (only for editing out pauses/errors and blurring sensitive information)

- Willingness to learn & attention to detail



REQUIRED TOOLS:

- A computer and a smartphone

- Good microphone (good audio quality, no background noise, etc.)

- OBS (recommended) or any other recording software

- Trello (for workflow management)

- Discord / WhatsApp for communication

*If you’ve got any other tools (such as gaming consoles,…), please let me know, since that’s a big plus!



RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will get the topics for the videos (e.g. “how to delete an Instagram account”), record them (+explain what’s happening using your own voice), cut out the pauses & mistakes, and upload the videos to Google Drive. That’s literally it.



DAY-TO-DAY TASKS: 

Every day, you will get a set amount of topics to record. You will then simply have to record tutorials on those topics and upload them to Google Drive. We will start with 15 videos a day, and if you do a good job, we can increase the number, which will increase your earnings as well.



PAYMENT:

The payment is $1.20 per video, and if you do a good job, stay consistent, deliver on time and make sure the quality is top-notch, I’m willing to increase the per-video rate, as well as reward you with bonuses. These videos don’t require much time to make, and when you get used to it, you could easily make a few videos per hour, meaning your hourly rate will likely exceed $6 per hour. With the initial 15 videos per day, we’re looking at around $540 per month.



This is a work-from-home job with flexible hours! It doesn’t matter when you work; the only thing that matters is that work is done. No special prior experience is needed, as recording these videos is very simple with some common computer skills.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Apply for the job

2. Send us a message, telling us a bit about yourself and why you think you’d be great for this job. 

3. Send us a sample of your previous work. If you’ve never recorded a video, you can just record a simple tutorial called “how to upload an image in Google Sheets” and send us that.

4. Begin the application with the word “Pineapple”, so we know you read this entire thing.



When you get hired, there’s a paid test period of 3 recorded videos. I never ask for unpaid work.



Best regards, and we’re looking forward to working with you!

title: Lightroom Photo Editor - Sports / BJJ Competition Photography

THE WORK



Sort/cull raw competition photos down to keepers, then batch-edit to a consistent style using presets I'll provide. Edit order: White Balance, then Exposure, then Tone, then Presence, then HSL, then Detail, then Crop. Typical turnaround is competition shot on a Sunday, full gallery sorted and edited by Thursday. Consistency across a whole gallery matters more than any single perfect photo, this is a clean, true to colour sports editing style, not heavy creative or editorial work. Skin tone and uniform colour accuracy are important since these photos go to paying clients and an online store.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Experience with Lightroom batch editing and presets. Fast, consistent output, able to average around 20 to 30 edited photos per hour once trained on my workflow. Reliable availability around competition weekends, Sunday to Thursday cycle. Comfortable with confidentiality, some galleries involve minors and are not to be shared or retained after delivery.



Happy to run a small paid trial batch first before discussing an ongoing arrangement. Presets and a full style guide provided.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor

*** Please read through the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it!

You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation.



Collaborative Design: Act as the internal design resource for our video editors. You will build the lower thirds, callouts, and technical diagrams their edits need.



Web and Digital Assets: Design high-fidelity web page elements and marketing collateral that fit our brand and our clients' technical standards.



Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Technical Stack: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or similar motion and design software.



Portfolio: A strong reel of explainer and motion graphics work, plus a portfolio of clean, functional graphic design (web elements, technical icons, diagrams).



Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines.

Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)

- Technical illustration or data and diagram visualization

- Brand and identity design

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Motivated Motion Graphics Artist - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best motion and static design work. No portfolio means no consideration.

title: LinkedIn SDR from your own profile (part time, 30 to 45 minutes a weekday)
description:
I am hiring several people to do LinkedIn outreach by hand for a B2B outbound agency. You work as a part time SDR from your own real LinkedIn profile. I give you the list and the messages, you do the clicks.



What you do

1. Add our company as your current position on LinkedIn (SDR, part time). It is true, you work for us part time. You get the company name when you are shortlisted.

2. Each weekday, send up to 20 connection requests to the people on the list I give you.

3. When someone accepts, send them the message I give you. There are 2 short follow ups after that, also written by us.

4. Log every reply in a shared sheet and pass the interested ones to our sales team the same day. You never have to sell and you never take calls.



How it works

1. You do every click yourself. You never give us your password and we never log in to your account. No automation tools.

2. Messages are in English or German. We write them and you paste them. If a reply comes in German you just pass it on.

3. It is your own profile, so you should know that LinkedIn can limit any account that sends a lot of requests. That is why we stay at 20 a day and do it by hand.



What I need from you

1. A real LinkedIn profile in your own name with your own photo, at least 1 year old, with 200 or more connections.

2. Written English good enough to follow a checklist word for word and to report what you saw.

3. 30 to 45 minutes every weekday, any time of day.

4. Reliability. If you say it is done today, it is done today.



Pay

8 to 10 USD an hour, paid monthly. Every hour is paid, including the first one. It starts at about 11 to 16 hours a month and it is steady work.



How to apply

Reply with 3 things. First, how old your LinkedIn profile is and how many connections it has. Second, the time of day you would do the work. Third, 2 lines on what you do when a prospect replies "who are you and why are you messaging me".

s and administrative work rather than growing the agency.

title: Experienced Part Time Cold Call Appointment Setter (2+ Years) for Commercial Cleaning, Healthcare Offices (US)
description:
Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company for healthcare offices in Fairfield County, Connecticut (
). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at healthcare offices and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator or owner.



Your standard is 100 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a healthcare practice: its patients, its staff and its reputation. Worked at a commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services company? That is a strong plus.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, mostly Tuesday to Thursday. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is 10 PM to 12 AM and 1 AM to 4 AM until November 1, then one hour later because US clocks change. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$25 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

At least 2 years of experience as an outbound cold calling appointment setter, booking appointments for service businesses, to businesses or to consumers. Home services, cleaning, healthcare, insurance and similar services count. Calling US customers for a client, at a call center or as a freelancer, counts. If you do not have 2 years of appointment setting by cold calling, do not apply.



You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.



A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.



HOW TO APPLY

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, [the hourly pay range in this post], [your name]. I do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to healthcare offices near you. Are you the person who d
 on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. Make sure the link opens without a login.

2. Your years of cold calling appointment setting experience, what services you booked appointments for, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Tell us if you have worked for a cleaning or facility services company.

3. The CRMs you have used.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week?



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed. Finalists do a 10 minute live role-play call with me.



Applications close Monday, October 12 at 11:59 PM Philippine time. I reply only to finalists, by Wednesday, October 14.



Johan Montenegro, Keeper Facility Care

title: Genesys Cloud CX Developer
description:
Position: Genesys Cloud CX Developer / CCaaS Engineer

Engagement: Contract / Remote

Experience: 4+ years in Contact Center / CCaaS, with strong hands-on Genesys Cloud CX experience

Availability: Must be available for regular collaboration during U.S. Central Time business hours



Role Overview



We are looking for an experienced Genesys Cloud CX Developer to provide hands-on engineering support for an enterprise contact-center environment. The developer will work primarily on Genesys Cloud configuration, Architect flows, IVR, routing, integrations, APIs, automation, troubleshooting, testing, and deployment processes.



This is a hands-on technical role. The ideal candidate should be able to independently analyze requirements, investigate existing Genesys configurations, develop solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver clean, documented changes.



Responsibilities



Design, develop, modify, and troubleshoot Genesys Cloud Architect inbound, outbound, and common module flows.



Configure and maintain IVR logic, ACD routing, queues, skills, wrap-up codes, schedules, data actions, callbacks, and related contact-center components.



Support voice and digital interactions including voice, chat, messaging,
, SMS, and other Genesys-supported channels.



Develop and maintain integrations using Genesys Cloud APIs, REST APIs, OAuth, JSON, webhooks, and Genesys Cloud Data Actions.



Build supporting services and automation using JavaScript, Node.js, and Python.



Integrate Genesys Cloud with external enterprise applications and cloud services.



Troubleshoot complex issues involving Architect flows, routing, telephony, integrations, API requests, authentication, data actions, and application behavior.



Work with Genesys Cloud Developer Tools and APIs to inspect, export, compare, and automate configuration.



Support migration of contact-center functionality from legacy platforms into Genesys Cloud CX.



Help automate Genesys Cloud configuration management and deployment processes to reduce manual changes between environments.



Contribute to CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code initiatives for Genesys configuration where technically appropriate.



Develop automated validation and regression testing for contact-center flows and integrations.



Support production issue investigation through logs, API traces, interaction details, analytics, and Genesys Cloud diagnostic information.



Create clear technical documentation covering configurations, Architect flows, APIs, integrations, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting.



Participate in technical discussions and provide practical recommendations for scalable and maintainable Genesys Cloud solutions.



Required Skills



Strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX.



Strong experience with Genesys Architect, including inbound call flows, common modules, tasks, decisions, data actions, error handling, and reusable flow design.



Strong understanding of ACD routing, queues, skills, routing methods, IVR, callbacks, schedules, and contact-center concepts.



Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud REST APIs and Platform API.



Experience building and troubleshooting Genesys Cloud Data Actions.



Good working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and API authentication.



Development experience with JavaScript / Node.js and Python.



Experience with AWS or Azure and cloud-based application integrations.



Understanding of microservices and event-driven architectures.



Experience troubleshooting production contact-center issues and identifying root causes.



Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD workflows.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to work independently and communicate technical blockers quickly.



Preferred Skills



Experience with Genesys Cloud migrations from Avaya, Cisco, NICE, or other legacy contact-center platforms.



Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code for Genesys Cloud.



Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for Genesys Cloud configuration.



Experience with automated testing of Architect flows, APIs, integrations, or contact-center functionality.



Knowledge of Genesys Cloud outbound campaigns and dialer functionality.



Experience with conversational AI, bots, NLU, intelligent routing, or Genesys AI capabilities.



Experience with reporting, analytics, interaction data, and operational monitoring.



Experience working in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated enterprise environment.



Genesys Cloud certifications are preferred but not mandatory.



What We Need



We need someone who is genuinely hands-on with Genesys Cloud rather than someone whose experience is primarily theoretical or administrative. You should be comfortable opening an unfamiliar Genesys environment, understanding existing Architect flows and routing configurations, debugging issues, modifying configurations, working with APIs, and explaining exactly what you changed and why.



The work will involve both feature development and troubleshooting, so strong practical Genesys Cloud experience is the most important qualification

title: International Construction Sourcing & Procurement Specialist
description:
Technical Sourcing & Construction Specification Analysis



Ability to review and interpret architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings; construction specifications; Bills of Quantities (BOQ); Bills of Materials (BOM); scopes of work; material submittals; and project requirements. Evaluate supplier and manufacturer quotations to ensure proposed materials and products meet project specifications, applicable standards, and performance requirements while allowing accurate apple-to-apple commercial comparison.



International Material Sourcing & Supplier Identification



Ability to identify, evaluate, and develop qualified domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers for construction materials, building products, equipment, and selected finishes. Conduct global market research to identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities from the United States and international markets while considering material quality, technical compliance, production capacity, shipping requirements, tariffs and duties, customs clearance, lead times, and overall supply-chain risk.



Potential sourcing categories may include structural steel and miscellaneous metals, reinforcing steel, precast products, doors and windows, architectural finishes, flooring, cabinetry, plumbing fixtures, electrical products, lighting, HVAC-related materials, site-development materials, drainage products, geosynthetics, landscaping materials, and other construction-related products where international procurement can provide measurable cost advantages.



Value Engineering & Material Cost Optimization



Ability to review specified materials and construction requirements and identify fit-for-purpose alternatives that reduce project cost without compromising structural integrity, safety, durability, quality, code compliance, aesthetics, or required performance. Work with project management, estimating, design teams, engineers, architects, subcontractors, and owners to evaluate alternative manufacturers, equivalent products, material substitutions, standardized specifications, and other value-engineering opportunities.



Construction Material Compliance & Product Qualification



Ability to verify that proposed domestic and imported construction materials comply with project specifications, approved plans, applicable building codes, and relevant industry standards such as ASTM, ANSI, ACI, AISC, UL, NFPA, and other standards required by the project. Coordinate technical data sheets, certificates, laboratory test reports, samples, shop drawings, product certifications, warranties, and other documentation required for material approval and construction submittals.



Supplier & Manufacturer Capability Assessment



Ability to assess supplier and manufacturer capabilities, including production facilities, equipment, technical competency, capacity, quality-control procedures, certifications, testing capabilities, manufacturing lead times, export experience, packaging methods, and ability to consistently meet project schedules and quality requirements. Conduct or coordinate supplier prequalification, factory evaluations, third-party inspections, and quality verification when appropriate.



Strategic Sourcing & Construction Procurement
