title: Mortgage Support (Associate/Specialist/Sr. Associate) from (AU) – Australian Market
description:
Location: Fully Remote - Work From Home

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience and role placement



About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Direct, proven experience supporting brokers or lenders within the Australian commercial real estate or development finance market.

- Deep proficiency in reading and validating corporate financials (ABN, BAS, NOA) and understanding commercial project metrics (feasibility models, construction drawdowns).

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

- Exceptional analytical capacity and sharp attention to detail.



[CAREER 3] MORTGAGE SUPPORT – SR. ASSOCIATE (Residential Expertise & Team Leadership)



Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior team members to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.



Key Responsibilities:

- Advanced Pre-Qualification: Conduct initial high-net-worth client consultations to map out homeownership strategies; evaluate complex serviceability and creditworthiness using tools like Quickli and applying the 5 Cs of Lending.

- Complex Loan Structuring: Educate clients on advanced loan combinations and recommend optimal solutions tailored to multi-property portfolios, expertly balancing fixed vs. variable splits and flexible repayment terms.

- CRM & Pipeline Management: Guide clients smoothly through applications while managing files end-to-end utilizing advanced mortgage CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Creatio, and Salestrekker.

- Secure Document Workflows: Oversee the secure and rapid execution of digital documentation utilizing platforms such as DocuSign and Ezidox, ensuring zero data-integrity errors.

- Credit Analysis & Compliance Auditing: Deeply analyze credit bureau reports, formulate credit improvement roadmaps for clients, and ensure absolute adherence to Australian mortgage regulations, including Loan Estimates and Closing Disclosures.

- Post-Closing & Settlement Excellence: Coordinate final document compilation to guarantee frictionless loan settlements; support clients post-settlement with direct debit structures, offset account setups, and ongoing client care.

- Business Development & Networking: Proactively build and nurture long-term relationships with core referral networks (real estate agencies, accounting firms, wealth managers) leveraging LinkedIn, industry forums, and freelancer platforms.

- Team Mentorship & System Optimization: Act as an escalation point and mentor for junior support staff; spearhead internal process improvements to accelerate client onboarding and minimize application turnaround times.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Significant, hands-on experience in the Australian residential mortgage industry managing end-to-end file flows.

- Mastery of Australian mortgage software and CRMs (specifically Salestrekker, Quickli, Salesforce, or Creatio).

- Experience mentoring team members, reviewing loan files for quality assurance, or leading process improvements.

- Masterful communication, negotiation, and problem-resolution abilities.



Common Requirements Across All Paths:

- Fluency in professional written and spoken English, with exceptional communication skills suitable for interacting with Australian brokers, lenders, and clients.

- High organizational capability with a demonstrated ability to multitask under tight financing deadlines.

- Adaptability to work hours aligned with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

- High-speed internet access and a dedicated, professional workspace (for remote positions).

What We Offer:

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive 



Location: Remote 

Company: Diversified Group with operations in Australia, China, and Hong Kong 

Industries: Professional Services, Agriculture, Manufacturing 

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent 

Salary: Competitive package commensurate with experience 



About Us 



We are a dynamic and diversified group running three distinct businesses across the Asia-Pacific region: 



- A Professional Accountancy & Advisory Firm with offices in Sydney, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. 



- Strawberry Farms in Victoria and Queensland, Australia. 



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team. The ideal candidate will support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing activities across our businesses. 



This is a hands-on and varied role covering social media, content marketing, email marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, website marketing, and campaign reporting. 



You will work closely with the Marketing Manager and internal teams to help turn marketing strategies into well-executed campaigns that build brand awareness, generate leads, and support business growth. 



If you are interested in working with international brands across different industries, enjoy both creative and analytical work, and want to develop experience across the full digital marketing mix, we'd love to hear from you. 



Role & Responsibilities:



- The responsibilities of this role are varied and involve both creative and analytical tasks. While experience in several areas is preferred, we are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and eager to develop their skills. 



Key responsibilities include: 



- Support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing campaigns across multiple brands and industries. 



- Manage and grow digital marketing activities across relevant channels, including social media, email, websites, search, and paid advertising. 



- Plan, create, schedule, and coordinate marketing content using content calendars. 



- Assist in developing and implementing digital marketing strategies aligned with each brand's business goals. 



- Create and coordinate social media, website, blog, email, and campaign content. 



- Write engaging marketing copy, including social media captions, email campaigns, promotional content, landing page copy, and advertisements. 



- Support lead generation activities through digital campaigns, social media, email marketing, and other relevant channels. 



- Assist with the creation, scheduling, and optimization of email marketing campaigns and customer communications. 



- Support the management of paid advertising campaigns, particularly on Meta platforms and other relevant channels. 



- Monitor website traffic, campaign activity, audience engagement, leads, and conversions. 



- Track and report on key marketing performance metrics, including website traffic, engagement, leads, conversions, email performance, and advertising results. 



- Analyze campaign performance and provide insights and recommendations to improve results. 



- Conduct market, competitor, audience, and keyword research to identify marketing opportunities. 



- Support SEO and website content optimization initiatives. 



- Assist with landing pages and other digital assets to improve lead generation and conversion. 



- Test and optimize marketing content, messaging, audiences, creatives, and campaigns based on performance data. 



- Actively stay up to date with digital marketing trends, platform updates, SEO, advertising strategies, and emerging marketing tools. 



- Collaborate with the Marketing Manager, designers, content creators, and other internal teams to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with brand messaging. 



- Manage multiple campaigns, projects, content schedules, and priorities across the group's different businesses. 



Preferred Skills:



- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. 



- Strong interest and understanding of digital marketing and the customer journey. 



- Experience with social media marketing and content management. 



- Basic understanding of paid advertising platforms, particularly Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. 



- Familiarity with email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO, keyword research, and website optimization. 



- Strong copywriting skills with the ability to create engaging and conversion-focused content. 



- Analytical mindset with attention to marketing and campaign performance metrics. 



- Organized and able to manage multiple campaigns, brands, and deadlines. 



- A proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 



- Ability to balance creative thinking with data-driven decision-making. 



Requirements:



- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, social media, content marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, or a related role. 



- Experience supporting or managing digital marketing campaigns across one or more channels. 



- Experience managing social media platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, or similar channels. 



- Experience creating digital marketing content, including social media posts, email campaigns, promotional copy, or website content. 



- Basic to intermediate understanding of paid advertising, including audience targeting, ad creatives, campaign setup, and optimization. 



- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, email marketing platforms, or similar marketing tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO principles, keyword research, and content optimization. 



- Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement. 



- Ability to interpret key digital marketing metrics such as engagement, reach, CTR, conversion rate, leads, and campaign performance. 



- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. 



- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously. 



- Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently in a remote environment. 



- Experience working with multiple brands or industries is an advantage. 



- Experience using Canva, WordPress, Shopify, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools is a plus. 



- Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment is an advantage. 



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not required. 



What We're Looking For:



- We are looking for a hands-on, well-rounded, and commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys turning ideas and strategies into action. 



- The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different areas of digital marketing and can balance creativity with performance. You should be curious about what drives results and willing to continuously test, learn, and improve. 



You should be able to ask not only: 



"How can we make this campaign look good?" 



but also: 



"How can we make this campaign perform better and contribute to awareness, leads, conversions, or business growth?" 



What We Offer:



Diverse Challenge: Escape the monotony of working in a single industry. Apply and develop your digital marketing skills across three distinct businesses in Professional Services, Agriculture, and Manufacturing. 



Broad Marketing Experience: Gain hands-on exposure across social media, content marketing, lead generation, email marketing, paid advertising, SEO, website optimisation, and analytics. 



Professional Growth: This role reports directly to the Marketing Manager and offers significant opportunities to expand your responsibilities and advance as the companies grow. 



International Exposure: Work with businesses and teams across Australia, China, and Hong Kong. 



Remote Flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the Philippines with a stable internet connection. 



Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary package commensurate with experience, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses. 



Supportive Environment: Work closely with the Marketing Manager and receive support from the wider team and ownership group, with access to the resources needed to succeed. 



How to Apply 



Ready to build something exceptional? Please send your application with the subject line: 



Application: Digital Marketing Executive – [Your Name] 



Your application must include: 



Your updated CV/Resume. 



A cover letter that addresses: 



1. Why you are interested in working as a Digital Marketing Executive across different businesses and industries. 



2. A brief example of a digital marketing campaign you have worked on, including the channels used and key results or learnings. 



3. Your experience across the digital marketing areas most relevant to this role. 



4. Your salary expectation. 



5. Optional but highly valued: Links to your portfolio, LinkedIn profile, relevant campaign examples, or case studies. 



Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. 



We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity in our team.

title: Full-Time Personal Brand Content Editor
description:
**Starting Salary:** $400 USD/month  

**Schedule:** Full-Time — 40 hours/week  

**Position:** Long-Term  

**Content:** Cameras, Videography, Filmmaking & Creator Education



## ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a professional videographer, filmmaker and content creator looking for a **full-time video editor dedicated to my personal brand**.



I create educational content about cameras, camera equipment, videography, filmmaking, sports videography and my experiences working professionally in the industry.



I will primarily handle **recording the content**.



Your responsibility will be turning those recordings into polished YouTube videos and then repurposing that content into short-form videos for social media.



The goal is simple:



**I record. You edit. We publish consistently.**



---



## THE CONTENT



Topics may include:



- Camera tips

- Videography tips

- Camera settings

- Camera equipment

- Lenses

- Camera comparisons

- Filmmaking techniques

- Sports videography

- Editing tips

- Behind-the-scenes filmmaking

- Gear I use

- Lessons I've learned as a videographer

- How I shoot different projects

- My experiences working on real productions



Most videos will begin with me speaking directly to the camera.



Your job is to make those videos visually interesting.



---



# YOUTUBE EDITING



You'll take my talking-head recordings and turn them into complete YouTube videos.



This may include:



- Removing mistakes and pauses

- Creating good pacing

- Cleaning audio

- Basic color correction

- Adding music when appropriate

- Adding text and simple graphics

- Punch-ins and reframing

- Adding relevant B-roll

- Adding photos or screenshots when appropriate

- Creating clean transitions

- Preparing the finished video for YouTube



I do NOT want unnecessary effects just to make the edit look complicated.



**The information and story should drive the edit.**



---



# USING MY SHOOT FOOTAGE AS B-ROLL



You'll have access to footage I've filmed while working as a professional videographer.



A major part of your job will be finding **relevant footage that supports what I'm saying.**



For example:



If I'm discussing **shooting 120 FPS**, show examples of my slow-motion sports footage.



If I'm discussing **low-light camera performance**, show footage I've captured in low-light environments.



If I'm discussing **sports videography**, use footage from actual basketball or football shoots.



If I'm talking about a particular camera or lens, use relevant footage of the equipment or footage created with that equipment when available.



The goal isn't simply to cover my talking head with random B-roll.



**The B-roll should help explain the topic.**



---



# TURN YOUTUBE VIDEOS INTO SHORT-FORM CONTENT



Another major responsibility will be repurposing each recording.



Our workflow will look like:



**Talking-Head Recording**



↓



**YouTube Video**



↓



**Multiple Short-Form Videos**



You'll identify strong moments from the longer recording that can become individual pieces of content for:



- Instagram Reels

- TikTok

- YouTube Shorts



Short-form edits may include:



- 9:16 formatting

- Captions

- Strong opening hooks

- B-roll

- Punch-ins

- Music

- Sound effects

- Simple graphics

- Fast, clean pacing



I want to get as much useful content as possible from every recording session.



---



# CONTENT REPURPOSING



Part of your job will be developing an eye for content.



For example, I may record a 20-minute conversation about camera settings.



That recording might become:



**1 YouTube Video**



plus



**5–10 potential short-form clips**



Instead of waiting for me to tell you every clip to create, I want you to gradually become capable of identifying those opportunities yourself.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



I'm looking for someone who:



- Understands YouTube editing

- Understands short-form social content

- Can edit talking-head videos

- Has good pacing

- Understands B-roll

- Can identify interesting moments

- Understands captions

- Can follow reference videos

- Is organized

- Communicates well

- Takes feedback well

- Wants to improve

- Can work independently after learning my style



An interest in **cameras, filmmaking, photography or videography** is a major plus.



You don't need to be an expert filmmaker.



You DO need to be interested in learning the subject matter so you understand what you're editing.



---



# SOFTWARE



**DaVinci Resolve is preferred.**



Experience with Photoshop, Canva, After Effects or similar software is a plus but not required.



---



# FULL-TIME WORK



This is intended to be a **full-time position**, not occasional freelance work.



There will be an ongoing library of:



- Talking-head recordings

- Sports footage

- Behind-the-scenes footage

- Camera footage

- Previous shoots

- Photos

- YouTube footage

- Social-media content



Part of the role will involve learning this footage library so you can quickly find relevant material for future videos.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**“CREATE MORE”**



Then answer:



1. Tell me briefly about yourself.

2. How long have you been editing?

3. What editing software do you use?

4. Send your 3 best editing examples.

5. Send your best talking-head edit.

6. Send your best short-form/Reels/TikTok edit.

7. Have you edited educational or tutorial content before?

8. Are you interested in cameras or filmmaking?

9. What computer do you edit on?

10. What is your internet speed?

11. Are you currently working another job?

12. Are you available to work full-time?



Finally, answer:



**If I gave you a 15-minute talking-head video explaining why I use a particular camera, what would you do to make the video visually interesting without distracting from what I'm teaching?**



Selected candidates may be asked to complete a **small paid editing test**.



I'm looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping me significantly increase the amount of content I publish.

- 3+ years of experience in short-term rental (STR) co-hosting, property management, or STR hospitality operations 

- You must have worked directly in a co-hosting, STR operations, or property management role supporting a portfolio of 50+ units 

- Hands-on experience with Hospitable

- Strong written and spoken English 

- Reliable internet, stable workspace, and full availability during your assigned shift



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and hospitality-driven. Someone who takes ownership of problems and solves them without being told to. Someone who can communicate with guests professionally under pressure, think clearly during difficult situations, and treat every interaction like it matters. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Your main focus is front-end guest communication. This includes messaging and calling guests, managing check-ins and check-outs, coordinating maintenance, communicating with cleaners and handymen, following up on open issues, screening reservations, and supporting channel communications.



SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES

You will also assist with backend tasks including claims filing, review removal, responding to reviews, listing creation and updates, and daily task tracking. Guest communication always comes first.



TOOLS WE USE

Hospitable, PriceLabs, Enso Connect, Ecobee, SuiteOp, Quo, WhatsApp, Monday.com



HOW TO APPLY

Reply to this listing with everything below included. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

- Your resume and a short message covering your total years in STR, the type of operation you worked for, and roughly how many units you managed or supported.



- A Loom video recorded at loom.com, between 3 and 5 minutes. Cover three things: your STR background and the types of operations you have worked for; walk through one specific difficult guest situation you personally handled and how you resolved it; and explain why you are applying to this role. Do not read from a script.



- Your written responses to the scenarios below. Take your time. This should take 20 to 30 minutes.



Scenario A: It is 11:30 PM. A guest sends this message: "The AC isn't working and it's 85 degrees in here. We have a baby. This is unacceptable. I want a full refund and I'm leaving a 1-star review." Your maintenance contact is not responding. The next available technician cannot come until 9 AM. Write the exact message you send to the guest right now. Write the exact message you send to the maintenance contact. Write what you log in the daily report. Then in 2 to 3 sentences, explain why you responded to the guest the way you did.



Scenario B: It is 8:30 AM at the start of your shift. You open your task board and see four things. One: a guest checking in today at 3 PM is requesting early check-in at noon and the unit is not cleaned yet. Two: a guest who checked out this morning left a complaint about a broken shower head. Three: a review from 3 days ago has not been responded to. Four: a new reservation just came in flagged by Autohost for review. List these in the order you would handle them and explain why.

Scenario C: A guest checks out and leaves a 3-star review that says: "Good location but the team was slow to respond." You personally replied to every message within 15 minutes during their stay. Write the public response you would post.

Qualified applicants will be contacted for an interview. All new hires begin with a one-month paid trial period.

title: Experienced Embroidery Digitizer: DST/EMB to Barudan U03 Conversion (Wilcom Workspace)
description:
We are looking for an experienced embroidery digitizer to join our team full time (40 hours/week). Your main job will be converting embroidery files from .DST and .EMB formats into Barudan .U03 format so they are ready to run on our machines.



This is not just "open and save as." We need someone who understands how a design will actually sew out and can fix problems during conversion.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Convert .DST and .EMB files to .U03 (Barudan) format

- Check and correct stitch density, underlay, pull compensation, and trims

- Set correct color stops and needle sequence (DST files carry no color info)

- Clean up jump stitches, small stitches, and other issues that cause thread breaks

- Resize or edit designs when needed while keeping sew-out quality

- Keep files organized and named according to our system

- Communicate clearly about any file that cannot be converted cleanly



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years of professional embroidery digitizing experience

- Strong, hands-on experience with Wilcom Workspace (required)

- Solid understanding of DST, EMB, and Barudan U03 formats

- Knowledge of how fabric type affects digitizing (caps, knits, wovens, etc.)

- Good attention to detail and ability to work through a steady volume of files

- Reliable internet and a computer capable of running Wilcom Workspace

- Good written English

- Available 40 hours per week



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Barudan machines specifically

- Experience digitizing from scratch (artwork to stitches)



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Barudan Ready" so we know you read this post.

2. Tell us how many years you have used Wilcom Workspace and what version.

3. Describe your experience converting files to U03 format.

4. Attach or link samples of your digitizing work (sew-out photos are a big plus).



Shortlisted applicants will be need to demonstrate those skills on a video call.

title: Regenerative Wellness Sales and Client Concierge
description:
Calibrate IV is hiring a knowledgeable sales professional to manage inquiries about regenerative wellness services, with a strong focus on stem cells and exosomes.



We are looking for someone who can earn a prospective client’s trust, explain complex subjects clearly, and maintain the follow-up needed to move an inquiry toward a provider consultation and, where clinically approved, a paid booking.



You should be comfortable speaking with discerning clients, discussing premium pricing, and taking ownership of your sales pipeline.



The Role



You will serve as a primary contact for prospective clients interested in regenerative services. Your responsibility is to help them understand our approved service information and navigate consultation, intake, payment, and scheduling.



Clinical decisions remain with our licensed providers.



Your Responsibilities



Respond to inquiries through phone,
, website chat, and approved messaging channels.

Ask thoughtful questions to understand the client’s interests, location, preferred timing, and next steps.

Explain approved service information, pricing, and consultation procedures.

Schedule provider consultations and help clients complete intake forms.

Follow up consistently with interested prospects and outstanding proposals.

Assist clinically approved clients with payment and booking.

Coordinate availability and logistics with our clinical and operations teams.

Maintain relationships with existing clients and coordinate provider-approved follow-up appointments.

Keep CRM records current, including conversation notes, lead stage, next action, and outcome.

Report weekly on consultations, paid bookings, collected revenue, and reasons prospects did not proceed.



Regenerative Knowledge Required



You should understand:



What mesenchymal stem cells, or MSCs, are.

What exosomes are and how they differ from stem cells.

The difference between emerging research and established clinical evidence.

Why sourcing, product-specific regulatory status, physician oversight, and informed consent matter.

When a question requires a licensed provider’s response.



We will train you on Calibrate’s current offerings and approved materials. You must communicate accurately, acknowledge evidence limitations, and avoid guarantees or unsupported medical claims.



Who We Want



A strong communicator with excellent spoken and written English.

Proven experience in premium-service sales, appointment conversion, or client retention.

Working knowledge of regenerative medicine.

Confidence handling phone conversations and pricing objections.

Consistent follow-through and strong organization.

Experience using CRM systems, scheduling tools, live chat, and Google Workspace.

Professional judgment and discretion with sensitive information.

Reliable internet with backup, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset.

Experience with regenerative medicine practices, longevity clinics, medical spas, or concierge healthcare is strongly preferred. Shopify and Chatra experience are a plus.



Compensation and Schedule



Base pay: $6 USD per hour

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Agreed US Eastern Time business hours

Additional performance compensation may be available. Any incentive arrangement will be provided in writing, including eligibility and payment terms, before you accept the position.



Required Video Application



Submit a 3–5 minute sales demonstration video. Treat the camera as a prospective client interested in Calibrate’s regenerative services.



Your demonstration should:



Open with a professional introduction and questions about the client’s interests.

Explain stem cells and exosomes in clear, accessible language.

Respond to: “Why does this cost so much?”

Respond to: “What evidence is there that this works?”

Guide the conversation toward scheduling a provider consultation.



Review 
 for company context. This is a simulated conversation, not a request to contact clients. Do not recommend treatment, promise results, or present investigational applications as proven care.



We are assessing your communication, subject knowledge, accuracy, judgment, and ability to establish a clear next step. A simple phone or webcam recording is sufficient. No editing is required, and the video will be used solely for recruitment evaluation.



**Applications without the sales demonstration video will not be considered.**

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Software QA Analyst 

Location: Cebu or Manila, Philippines (Remote-first, aligned to Australian business hours – AEST) 

Employment Type: Project Based/Casual



The Role 

The Software QA Analyst will be responsible for ensuring software quality across development and IT-related projects through both manual and automated testing. You will design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, perform thorough manual testing, run automated scripts, track defect metrics, and debug issues. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and project stakeholders to conduct testing prior to product launches, ensuring software runs smoothly, meets client specifications, and aligns with high quality and cost-effectiveness standards. 



Responsibilities: 

Review system requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback. 

Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing. 

Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate QA and testing activities. 

Perform hands-on manual QA testing across functional, non-functional, UI/UX, and system integration workflows. 

Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using open-source tools. 

Identify, record, thoroughly document, and track bugs and software defects. 

Perform thorough manual and automated regression testing once bugs are resolved. 

Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client requirements. 

Liaise with internal technical teams (e.g., developers, product managers, delivery leads) to clarify system requirements and acceptance criteria. 

Monitor debugging process results and investigate the root causes of non-conforming software. 

Track quality assurance metrics (e.g., defect densities, open defect counts, test execution progress). 

Stay up to date with new testing tools, manual QA techniques, and test automation strategies. 



What We're Looking For 

5+ years of proven work experience in software development and software quality assurance. 

Strong practical experience in Manual QA testing, functional testing, cross-browser/device testing, and exploratory testing. 

Deep understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, framework design, and release management processes.

, or equivalent platforms.

Strengthen CI/CD with reliable checks, reproducible builds, deployment verification, and rollback procedures.

Diagnose and fix production bugs across the Python backend, React frontend, databases, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.

Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance visibility so failures are detected early and traced to their root cause.

Investigate issues involving WebSockets, asynchronous execution, audio streaming, timeouts, concurrency, and connection lifecycle management.

Review production architecture and recommend practical improvements to reliability, scalability, security, maintainability, and cost.

Document operational procedures and work closely with the founder to prioritize and deliver improvements.





Required experience



4+ years of professional, hands-on software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of production systems.

Strong Python skills, including asynchronous programming, API development, and debugging backend services; experience with FastAPI or a comparable framework.

Hands-on AWS and Docker experience, including container deployments, networking, IAM, logs, and production troubleshooting. Experience with ECS/Fargate and ECR is particularly relevant.

Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems.

Ability to diagnose and fix React and JavaScript issues in a production web application.

Practical experience with PostgreSQL, Redis or Valkey, and distributed data consistency.

Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, processes and threads, event loops, memory and CPU profiling, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, DNS, and WebSockets.

Experience investigating race conditions, resource leaks, blocking operations, dropped connections, and performance bottlenecks.

Experience integrating external APIs and handling OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and duplicate prevention.

Ability to evaluate architecture tradeoffs and deliver incremental improvements to an existing production system.

Clear communication, strong ownership, and evidence of personally building, deploying, and supporting working software.

You should have strong experience with the core engineering and infrastructure technologies. Prior experience with every individual provider is not required.





Helpful additional experience



Real-time voice, telephony, streaming audio, or conversational AI systems.

Low-level programming in C, C++, Rust, or Go, especially for networking, concurrency, or performance work.

Infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.

Load testing, failure simulation, synthetic monitoring, and automated evaluations of AI behavior.

title: Online Tutor
description:
# NOW HIRING: Online / Virtual Tutors

**Subjects: Algebra, Science, English & Biology**



**Job Type:** Part-Time / Remote  

**Location:** Work From Home (anywhere)

**Students:** Grade 5 and Grade 9 (US Curriculum)  

**Schedule:** To Be Discussed (Must Be Available During US Hours)



### Job Description



We are looking for **experienced, passionate, and engaging online tutors** to provide personalized, one-on-one instruction to two homeschooled boys in Grades 5 and 9.



We are seeking tutors who specialize in **Algebra, Science, English, and Biology** and can help students develop a strong academic foundation, improve their critical thinking skills, and become confident, independent learners.



Candidates may apply to teach one or multiple subjects, depending on their qualifications and expertise.



### Key Responsibilities



- Conduct interactive, engaging, and structured online tutoring sessions.

- Provide subject-specific instruction appropriate to each student's grade level and learning needs.

- Follow the students' existing curriculum and supplement lessons with additional learning resources when necessary.

- Assist with homework, assignments, projects, and test preparation.

- Identify learning gaps and develop strategies to address academic challenges.

- Encourage critical thinking, problem-solving, independent learning, and effective study habits.

- Monitor academic performance and provide regular progress reports.

- Prepare lesson materials, practice exercises, and assessments as needed.

- Communicate proactively with parents regarding student progress, challenges, and recommendations.



### Subjects We Are Hiring For



**1. Mathematics / Algebra Tutor**

- Strong knowledge of Grade 5 Mathematics and/or Grade 9 Algebra.

- Ability to explain mathematical concepts clearly and develop students' problem-solving skills.



**2. Science / Biology Tutor**

- Experience teaching elementary science and/or high school Biology.

- Ability to simplify complex scientific concepts and incorporate interactive learning activities.



**3. English Tutor**

- Experience teaching English Language Arts (ELA) at elementary and/or high school levels.

- Strong background in grammar, reading comprehension, vocabulary, essay writing, and literary analysis.



### Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Education or a relevant subject area preferred.

- At least 2 years of teaching or tutoring experience preferred.

- Experience teaching the US curriculum is highly desirable.

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Ability to adapt teaching strategies to different grade levels and learning styles.

- Patient, enthusiastic, organized, and passionate about education.

- Comfortable using online teaching platforms such as Zoom, Google Meet, and interactive digital whiteboards.

- Strong time-management skills and a commitment to maintaining a consistent teaching schedule.

- Experience working with homeschooled students is an advantage.



### Technical Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Laptop or desktop computer with a functioning webcam and microphone.

- Quiet, professional, and distraction-free teaching environment.

- Ability to use digital teaching tools and share interactive learning materials.



### How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit the following:



1. Updated resume highlighting relevant teaching experience.

2. Subject(s) and grade level(s) you are qualified to teach.

3. Brief description of your teaching approach and experience with the US curriculum.

4. Expected hourly tutoring rate in USD.

5. Availability, including preferred teaching hours in US Pacific Time.

6. Optional: A short teaching demonstration video or sample lesson plan.



**Shortlisted candidates may be invited to conduct a paid or unpaid trial lesson, with the arrangement confirmed in advance.**



**Join us in helping two young learners build academic confidence, strengthen their skills, and achieve their educational goals!**

title: GHL Specialist / VA
description:
DO BROKEN AUTOMATIONS BOTHER YOU MORE THAN THEY SHOULD?



Do you open a GHL workflow and immediately start noticing things you’d change?

Do you see a messy automation and think, “Why the hell is this built like this?”

Do you find yourself fixing things nobody technically asked you to fix because you know they’re going to become a problem later?



Do you have ideas for better systems, only to hear:

“Just do it the way we’ve always done it.”



If that sounds familiar, you might fit in here.



LaunchPad is looking for a GoHighLevel Specialist to help build, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve the systems behind our client accounts and internal operations.



We’re not looking for someone who only knows where the buttons are.



We want someone who looks at a system and thinks: How can this work better?



WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and optimize GHL workflows, automations, triggers, pipelines, calendars, forms, and custom fields

- Troubleshoot broken workflows, integrations, automations, and other GHL issues

- Handle small client requests, tweaks, and account changes

- Build and maintain automations using Zapier

- Connect platforms using APIs and webhooks

- Integrate GHL with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Sheets, CRMs, and other platforms

- Deploy and connect AI tools into automation flows

- Manage data syncing between GHL, Google Sheets, and other systems

- Support new client onboarding and backend setup

- Build and maintain funnels, forms, calendars, tracking, and automation infrastructure

- Work on LaunchPad’s internal systems and automations

- Assist with general VA/admin tasks when needed

- Communicate directly with clients when troubleshooting or implementing changes

- Take ownership of the systems you build and make sure they continue working properly



YOU’LL PROBABLY LIKE THIS ROLE IF...

You hate seeing obvious inefficiencies left unfixed.

You don’t need someone to tell you every single next step.

If something breaks, you start investigating before asking someone else to solve it for you.

You notice small details other people miss.

You’d rather understand why a system works than blindly follow instructions.

And if you see a better way to build something, you’ll actually tell us.

We want that.



REQUIREMENTS

You should already have hands-on experience with:

- GoHighLevel

- GHL workflows and triggers

- Pipelines and opportunities

- Calendars, forms, and custom fields

- Zapier

- APIs

- Webhooks

- Integrating multiple platforms together



You should also:

- Have strong written and spoken English

- Be comfortable communicating directly with clients

- Be good at troubleshooting and problem-solving

- Be able to work independently

- Have solid general VA/admin skills

- Be organized and able to manage multiple client accounts

- Have reliable internet and equipment

- Take ownership of results instead of simply completing tasks

- Be responsive and actively working during your scheduled hours



BONUS SKILLS

- Make

- n8n

- AI automation tools

- Meta Ads integrations

- Google Ads integrations

- Tracking and attribution

- Lead routing

- JavaScript or basic coding

- Previous marketing agency experience

- Experience working with home service businesses

- You’re funny



HOURS & PAY

- $4 USD/hour

- 6 hours/week to start

- Monday, Wednesday, Friday

- 2:00 PM–4:00 PM Vancouver time

- You are expected to be fully online, responsive, and actively working during your scheduled hours

- Additional paid hours may be required when we onboard new clients or have larger implementation projects

- As LaunchPad grows, there may be opportunities for more hours and responsibility



Your regular schedule will mostly involve maintenance, troubleshooting, client requests, internal systems, and small backend tasks.



When a new client joins, workload may temporarily increase while we complete their setup and onboarding.



WHO/WHAT IS LAUNCHPAD?

LaunchPad is a small, fast-moving marketing agency built for roofing and home service companies.

We run the ad campaigns and follow-up systems that turn leads into booked jobs.



We’re small enough that good people don’t stay invisible.



If you’re exceptional, we’re not going to make you wait three years for someone above you to quit before you get more responsibility.



Performance > Seniority.



You’ll work inside a growing agency, build systems for real clients, and get hands-on experience with how marketing, sales, automation, and client acquisition actually work together.



We don’t want people who need to be told what to do every hour.

You’ll know the result we need, and you’ll have the playbooks, tools, and support to get there.

Then we expect you to think.



If something breaks, your first instinct should be to figure it out, not wait for someone to rescue you.



If your current job keeps telling you: “That’s not your responsibility.”

when you’re trying to improve something... you’ll probably like it here.



If your only goal is finding the highest hourly rate possible, this probably isn’t the role for you.



If you want responsibility, feedback, real experience, and the chance to become extremely good at automation and backend systems, you’ll fit in much better here.



***HOW TO APPLY***

We don’t need your resume.

Send us a 2-minute video introduction.



In your video:

- Give us a quick introduction

- Tell us why you want the role

- Tell us about your experience with GoHighLevel

- Screen share a system or automation you built and walk us through how it works. Don’t just show us that it works.

Tell us why did you build it that way?



We want to see how you think.



Keep it casual. We care much more about whether you’re capable, resourceful, clear, and easy to work with than how good you are at interviewing.



Applications without a video link will not be considered.

title: Dedicated Premiere Pro Editor for Cruise Travel Channel
description:
About Us:

We run Port Lowdown, a fast-growing US-based digital media company. We help independent cruisers navigate global itineraries with zero friction. Having documented over 150 cruise ports, we are building a highly searchable video library that serves a passionate community of travelers. We operate with a culture of autonomy, extreme organization, and mutual respect. We are looking for a long-term team member to grow with us, starting part-time with a clear pathway to full-time.



The Role:

You will be working directly with our Post-Production Director, Troy. You will take over the assembly and initial cut phases of our flagship port guides.



This is not a gig where you have to organize a messy hard drive. You will receive a meticulously packaged Premiere Pro project file complete with proxies, color-coded pancake timelines, isolated audio tracks, pre-built stringouts, and a detailed voiceover transcript with director's notes. Your job is to take these organized ingredients and build compelling, fast-paced, high-retention travel episodes.



Key Responsibilities:



Build the "Hero" Hook: Craft dynamic, 60–90 second opening montages using our curated top 5% clips, archival "authority" footage, and standard MOGRT transition templates.



Navigate Pancake Timelines: Work from chronological stringouts utilizing our "Red Tag" chapter marker system on V2 to efficiently pull selects down to your master timeline.



Audio Balancing: Loosely edit the T1 narration track head-to-tail, mixing it with background music and preserving specific natural ambient sounds using J and L cuts and audio ducking.



Integrate Promos: Seamlessly drop in commercial assets (QR codes, PDF guide mockups) into mid-roll sections from dedicated project bins (e.g., 06_PROMOS_AND_CTAS).



Required Technical Mastery:



Premiere Pro Native: Highly proficient. (DaVinci Resolve familiarity is a bonus, but Premiere is our engine).



Proxy Workflow Expert: You must completely understand how to download a transfer folder, offline high-res media, attach local proxies, and work with the "Toggle Proxies" workflow to maintain our 4K (3840x2160) Rec. 2100 HLG / 29.97fps sequence settings.



File Management Discipline: You respect a rigid bin structure and understand why you only upload a newly versioned .prproj file back to our shared drive, rather than uploading massive media files.



VFR Handling: Knowledge of syncing and managing Variable Frame Rate screen recordings to avoid audio drift.



To Apply, You Must Follow These Exact Steps:



1. When you click apply, make the subject line of your message: 'Port Lowdown Editor: [Your Favorite Color]

2. Provide a link to ONE video you edited that best demonstrates your ability to hold viewer retention. Do not link a generic portfolio.

3. Write a brief paragraph explaining why you want to work on travel/cruise content specifically.

4. In one sentence, explain why working with proxies is crucial for a remote Premiere Pro workflow.



Note: Any application that does not follow these 4 steps perfectly will be immediately deleted without review.

title: CRO Shopify
description:
At Lantern Sol, we’re a dynamic, multicultural team of developers, designers, project managers, and SEO experts dedicated to building exceptional e-commerce websites on Shopify. We’ve helped companies generate over $100 million in e-commerce sales, developed 500+ custom websites and apps, and have been featured speakers on Shopify and Amazon.

Shape the future of commerce – Your work will directly impact businesses worldwide.

Flexible work environment – Work from anywhere, set your own schedule.

Join a thriving global team – Collaborate with top talent across multiple time zones.

Professional growth – Stay ahead with continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects.

Lantern Sol is looking for a part-time CRO Specialist to support our Shopify and eCommerce clients. This person will provide the deeper CRO expertise behind each account.



They will analyze customer and website data, develop testing hypotheses, guide experiment planning, evaluate results, and help communicate the business impact of the work to clients.

Each account will still have a Lantern Sol project manager responsible for the overall relationship, timelines, and coordination. Our internal design and development teams will handle execution. The CRO Specialist will own the strategy, analysis, and interpretation that guide the work.

What You’ll Do



Complete initial CRO audits using data from GA4, Shopify, testing platforms, heatmaps, session recordings, and other available sources.

Compare data across platforms to identify conversion issues, customer behavior patterns, and areas of opportunity.

Participate in recurring ideation sessions with project managers, designers, and developers.

Turn findings and ideas into clear, testable hypotheses.

Build and prioritize testing plans based on potential impact, available traffic, confidence, and level of effort.

Recommend an appropriate testing cadence for each client rather than applying the same process to every account.

Plan tests across different areas of the customer journey, such as the homepage, navigation, product pages, cart, and checkout.

Help structure simultaneous tests appropriately so results remain accurate and clients are not exposed to conflicting experiments.

Define the audience, success metrics, and measurement approach for each test.

Review experiment results and determine whether a hypothesis was confirmed, denied, or requires another iteration.

Translate both positive and negative test results into useful insights and clear next steps.

Estimate the potential business impact of test results using conversion rate, traffic, average order value, and projected revenue.

Update client reporting with results, screenshots, findings, and recommendations.

Join client calls when needed to explain testing strategy or present results.

Help Lantern Sol improve and document a consistent CRO process that can scale across accounts.

Use AI tools to support analysis, ideation, and reporting while applying independent judgment to the final recommendations.

You’re a Great Fit If You…

Have hands-on experience as a CRO strategist or specialist for Shopify, D2C, or eCommerce brands supporting multiple CRO clients.

Experience with Intelligems or similar Shopify experimentation platforms, creating and evaluating A/B or split tests.

Understand testing methodology, audience segmentation, sample size, statistical significance, and common factors that can make results unreliable.

Can work across GA4, Shopify Analytics, and CRO testing platforms to build a more complete view of performance.

Know how to turn data into focused hypotheses and practical testing plans.

Can prioritize several testing opportunities without running overlapping experiments that compromise the results.

Experience creating or presenting client-facing CRO reports: You know how to frame an unsuccessful experiment as a useful learning rather than simply reporting it as a loss.

Can explain data and testing results clearly to clients and team members who may not have a CRO background.

Are comfortable collaborating with project managers, designers, and developers without needing to manage the entire account.

Are organized, responsive, and able to support multiple accounts in a remote agency environment.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Figma and design-to-development workflows.

Experience helping an agency build or standardize its CRO delivery process.

title: eBay Ecommerce Manager | Product Research, Optimization & Dropshipping
description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly independent eBay Ecommerce Manager to help grow and optimize an established eBay USA store.

This is NOT a basic data-entry or copy-and-paste VA position. We need someone who understands eCommerce, product research, profitability, eBay optimization, and policy-compliant dropshipping.

The ideal candidate should be able to work independently, identify opportunities, solve problems, and make intelligent recommendations without needing constant instructions or supervision.

Main Responsibilities:

• Research profitable products with proven demand on eBay USA

• Analyze sold listings, competition, pricing, sell-through rate and market demand

• Calculate product cost, shipping, eBay fees, promoted listing costs and estimated NET profit before recommending a product

• Find reliable suppliers, preferably with inventory and fulfillment inside the USA

• Manage policy-compliant eBay dropshipping and avoid risky suppliers or practices that could affect account health

• Create and optimize eBay listings for maximum visibility and conversion

• Write strong SEO titles and complete accurate Item Specifics

• Optimize descriptions, pricing, Best Offer, Volume Pricing and Promoted Listings when appropriate

• Monitor supplier inventory and pricing

• Help manage orders, tracking, cancellations and supplier issues

• Identify low-performing listings and recommend improvements

• Research profitable product niches and new opportunities

• Understand eBay VeRO, intellectual property and account-health risks

• Maintain accurate records of product cost, selling price and estimated profit

Dropshipping Experience:

Experience with AutoDS or similar eCommerce automation software is strongly preferred.

You should understand product importing, stock monitoring, price monitoring, order processing and tracking automation.

We are interested in reliable wholesale suppliers and suppliers with US-based fulfillment. All sourcing methods must comply with eBay policies.

What We Are Looking For:

• Proven experience managing eBay USA stores

• Strong eBay product research experience

• Strong understanding of profitability and margins

• Experience with eBay dropshipping

• Experience with AutoDS is preferred

• Excellent listing optimization skills

• Ability to work independently

• Strong attention to detail

• Good communication

• Problem-solving mindset

• Able to identify opportunities instead of waiting for instructions

IMPORTANT:

We do NOT want someone who simply uploads hundreds of random products.

Quality and profitability are more important than quantity.

Every product recommendation should include:

• Supplier link

• Product cost

• Shipping cost

• eBay competitor examples

• Evidence of demand / recent sales

• Recommended selling price

• Estimated eBay fees

• Advertising / promoted listing estimate when applicable

• Estimated net profit

• ROI

• Supplier delivery time

• Competition level

• Potential VeRO / intellectual property concerns

2. Have you managed an eBay USA store?

3. What tools do you use for eBay product research?

4. Do you have experience with AutoDS?

6. What sell-through rate do you normally look for?

7. How do you identify possible VeRO or intellectual property risks?

8. What suppliers have you worked with?

9. How many profitable product opportunities can you realistically research per week?

10. Tell us about an eBay store you helped improve and what results you achieved.

Please begin your application with the words “EBAY GROWTH” so we know you carefully read the entire job description.

We are looking for a long-term relationship. The initial focus will be aggressively improving sales and profitability during Q4 while protecting the health of the eBay account.

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance may receive additional hours and performance-based compensation.

description:
About Propseller



In 2024, Propseller has been ranked #1 Fastest-Growing Real Estate Company in APAC by the Financial Times and #10 in Singapore’s fastest-growing companies 2024 by The Straits Times and Statista !



In August 2022, Propseller raised a US$12M Series A led by Vertex Ventures, the VC arm of Temasek, the investment company owned by the Government of Singapore and the Series A lead investor of Grab.



Propseller’s mission is to help people build wealth with real estate. We’re building an end-to-end real estate transaction platform and towards that goal, we started the journey by building a technology-powered real estate brokerage that is valuable, reliable and fairly priced.



By elevating the most human part of the service with top in-house agents and industrialising all the rest with technology and centralised operations, we became Singapore's most loved real estate agent with an average Google My Business rating of 4.8/5 (800+ reviews).



The next phase of the journey is to go from helping people sell their homes to becoming the No. 1 brand for people to move from one home to the next: sell, buy, and finance.



Find out more at: 
/careers/.



Role Description



We are looking for a cheerful, fast, and client-obsessed individual to join us as an Associate Customer Service Executive working remotely from the Philippines. In this role, you will support our team of Real Estate Consultants in Singapore by answering inbound enquiries, qualifying buyers, and coordinating property viewings, all while delivering a seamless and professional experience to every prospect.



You will play a key role in shaping the first impression of Propseller. Speed, accuracy, empathy, and organisation will be essential to succeed. If you love helping people, are naturally resourceful, and can thrive in a high-performance remote team, we would love to hear from you.

You understand what great service feels like, and you know how to deliver it, even remotely. You have a strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in everything you do, from client communication to system updates. You take pride in creating smooth, efficient, and positive experiences for clients, and you are not afraid to push for results when needed.



You are proactive, coachable, and always looking for ways to improve.



Requirements



- Diploma or equivalent qualification

- 1 year experience required in a remote customer service role

- Fluent in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally via chat and phone

- Comfortable using Google Workspace, CRMs, and digital tools in general

- High level of attention to detail, especially when updating client records and coordinating viewings

- Strong ability to multitask and stay focused under pressure

- Reliable internet connection and remote working setup suitable for daily video calls and platform use

- Organised, proactive, and customer-obsessed, always striving to deliver a premium experience



You Get

- Structured support & training: Get onboarded with clear guidance, regular check-ins, and ongoing coaching to help you thrive

- Above-market compensation: Receive competitive pay that reflects your skills and performance, significantly higher than local customer service contracts

- Exposure to startup culture: Join a high-performing and caring team that values initiative, learning, and collaboration, without the rigid structure of corporate environments

- Purpose & impact: Play a meaningful role in shaping the home-buying and selling experience of clients in one of life’s biggest milestones

Interview Process

title: Financial Controller (Australia - NetSuite)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Own the day-to-day finance function across the company and progressively take financial management responsibilities away from the CEO. - CPA – required.

- Strong month-end close and financial reporting experience.

- Budgeting, forecasting, and cash-flow management experience.

- Job costing, WIP, margin, and profitability analysis experience.

Systems
