title: Sales Operations Support Coordinator
description:
About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Ensure relevant team members receive everything needed for product launches and sales training.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Prepare and post sales recruitment advertisements on SEEK and other approved channels.

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

* Maintain accurate candidate records and prepare clear shortlists for management.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with applicants.

* Handle applicant information responsibly and confidentially.



Daily roster and attendance support

* Prepare and monitor the team’s daily break roster.

* Check arrival times and attendance against agreed schedules.

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

* Maintain accurate records so information can be easily reviewed when required.



Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Track actions, dependencies and risks and provide clear progress updates.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

* Carry projects through from initial instruction to completion, implementation and handover.

* Create or update the relevant SOP, checklist or supporting documentation when a project introduces a repeatable process.

* When project work competes with recurring responsibilities, confirm priorities with the manager so existing duties are not silently delayed or dropped.



General Operations: 

* Monitoring operations and reporting on performance.

* Helping implement new workflows, tools and processes.

* Troubleshooting operational issues.

* Coordinating across departments and with external suppliers.

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Supporting onboarding and SOP training.



How we expect you to work



We are looking for someone who:

* Is naturally curious and wants to understand the reason behind a task.

* Asks sensible questions when unsure instead of guessing or remaining silent.

* Listens carefully and follows instructions accurately.

* Takes responsibility for tasks from commencement through to completion.

* Pays close attention to details and checks their work before submitting it.

* Is reliable, responsible and consistent—even when working independently.

* Follows established processes rather than creating unnecessary shortcuts.

* Completes all reasonable duties within the role instead of selecting only preferred tasks.

* Approaches small routine tasks with the same care as larger projects.

* Keeps files, trackers, messages and priorities organized.

* Communicates early if a deadline may be missed or assistance is required.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

* Confidence in politely holding people accountable to agreed processes and deadlines.

* Ability to manage several recurring responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Experience maintaining SOPs, checklists, trackers or knowledge bases.

* Sound judgement when working with confidential recruitment and attendance information.

* Competence with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

* Experience coordinating or managing projects from initial brief through to completion.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and time-management skills.

* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

* Experience identifying operational bottlenecks and recommending practical improvements.

* Experience with Zoho Learn, other Zoho applications, SEEK or an Australian business will be highly regarded but is not essential.



Working arrangements

* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Hours: Mondays to Fridays 9am-5.30pm

* Time zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time, including daylight-saving changes.

* Employment type: Full-time

* Salary: PHP 50,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and health-insurance benefits. 

* Start date: ASAP

* The successful candidate will require a reliable internet connection, a suitable home workspace and the ability to attend online meetings during the required working hours.



How to apply



Please submit:

* Your résumé.

* A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

* An example of a process, checklist, tracker or knowledge base you have maintained.

* An example of a task you managed from initial instruction through to completion.

* Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

* Your availability and notice period.



Please begin your application with the words “Sales Operations” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.

title: Phone Scheduling Coordinator - US Home Inspection Company (Permanent Weekend Night Shift Fri-Mon, Clear English + Sales Skills)
description:
BE THE VOICE OF A 5-STAR US COMPANY. PHONES ARE THE JOB.



Upspect Home Inspections is a growing home inspection company in Arizona, USA, with a 5-star Google rating and 350+ reviews. We are hiring one Phone Scheduling Coordinator for a permanent weekend shift (Friday to Monday) to answer our business line, book inspections, and win business from the real estate agents and homebuyers who call us.



This is a VOICE role. Most of your shift is live on the phone with Americans: agents booking inspections, buyers asking questions, and call-backs to online leads. Every call is a chance to earn a booking. If you have years on a US voice account and callers never guess you are overseas, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer every inbound call LIVE on our US business line (Quo/OpenPhone). We do not let calls go to voi
 and text back later.

- Book inspections in Spectora (we will train you), verifying every detail: address, square footage, year built, access, agent and client contacts.

- Quote pricing accurately and offer add-on services (sewer scope, pool, termite, and more).

- Turn price-shoppers into bookings: handle objections, offer alternatives, and ask for the booking.

- Call online leads back within minutes and follow up on unclosed quotes.

- Coordinate day-of logistics with our inspectors by text and Slack.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- CLEAR, NATURAL, EASILY UNDERSTOOD ENGLISH. This is the #1 requirement. Our customers are Americans and they must understand you easily on the first try. Neutral accent, confident, warm, and professional. We test this before we look at anything else.

- GREAT PHONE SKILLS. 2+ years on a US-facing VOICE account (customer service, scheduling, sales, insurance, telecom, healthcare). Chat-only or
-only experience does not count.

- SELLING SKILLS (strongly preferred). Experience in inbound or outbound sales, appointment setting, or anything where you were measured on closing.

- FULLY PRESENT FOR YOUR WHOLE SHIFT. A private, quiet workspace where you can take calls for the entire shift without interruptions or household responsibilities. You must be at your desk and available on the phone from clock-in to clock-out.

- Reliable attendance. You show up for every shift, on time, every time.

- Detail-oriented: you repeat details back, double-check, and never guess.

- Stable internet (25 Mbps+), USB noise-cancelling headset, and backup power/internet.



SCHEDULE (PERMANENT WEEKEND SHIFT, FRIDAY TO MONDAY)

- Full-time, 40 hours per week: four 10-hour shifts, every Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday.

- Friday: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM Arizona = Saturday 12:00 AM to 10:00 AM Manila

- Saturday and Sunday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Arizona = 11:00 PM to 9:00 AM Manila (starting Saturday and Sunday night)

- Monday: 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Arizona = Monday 10:00 PM to Tuesday 8:00 AM Manila

- Days off: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday (Arizona time).

- This is a permanent schedule that includes EVERY weekend. Arizona does not observe daylight saving, so Manila is always 15 hours ahead and these times never change.

- Apply only if working every weekend on a permanent night shift works for your life long-term.



WHAT YOU GET

- $5 to $7 per hour USD based on experience, paid weekly via Wise

- 13th month pay (performance-based, prorated in your first year)

- Long-term, full-time, direct hire (not an agency)

- Paid training with the owner and operations manager

- Raises tied to performance after 90 days

- A small, stable team that uses your feedback



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY. THIS IS YOUR FIRST TEST.)

Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.



1. Put the word MESQUITE in the first line of your application.

2. Confirm that you can permanently work every Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday on the schedule above, including every weekend.

3. Paste a link to a VOICE RECORDING (60 to 90 seconds, no script reading) on 
 or Google Drive (sharing set to "anyone with the link"), answering this scenario as if you are on the phone:

   "A homebuyer calls and says your price is $75 higher than another company's quote. They are about to hang up. Respond to them and try to book the inspection."

4. Paste a link to a SHORT VIDEO (30 to 60 seconds) showing the workspace where you will take calls, and tell us who else is usually home during your shift hours.

5. Tell us about your most recent US voice account: company/industry, how long, what kind of calls, and whether you had sales targets.

6. Confirm your internet speed (speedtest link) and that you have a USB headset.



Finalists complete a PAID full-length trial shift on our live phone line before we hire.

Creative instincts, visual taste, and experience with creator content matter much more.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Lifestyle influencers

• Beauty creators

• Fitness creators

• Health brands

TOOLS

CapCut

Canva

Google Drive



Experience with any of these is a plus:

• Lightroom

• Photoshop

• Premiere Pro

• AI creative tools

• Other editing/design software  



Using AI is completely fine if it helps improve your ideas, workflow, research, or final work.



WORKLOAD

We will initially start with approximately:

2 posts per week



As the workflow improves, we plan to gradually increase toward:

3 to 5+ posts per week



The role can grow over time as you become more involved in the creative direction of the page.



HOW TO APPLY

• Photo editing

• Content ideation

• Trend research

• Content planning  



2. Your Best Work

and

Female lifestyle, wellness, health, fitness, beauty, or personal brands.



3. Creative References





In a few sentences, tell us what you specifically notice and like about their content and visual styles.

Please be specific.



4. Creative Thinking

Imagine you are helping grow an Instagram page for a female health, wellness, and longevity creator.

Send us 3 specific content ideas you would recommend creating.



5. About You

Please include:

• Current availability

• Timezone

• Experience working with creators  



IMPORTANT



Begin your application with:

WELLNESS CREATIVE

Purchasing Agent / Virtual Assistant – Diabetic Buyback Business



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Standard Time | $5/hour ($800/month)



About the Role

We are a growing U.S.-based diabetic buyback business currently building out our Purchasing Agent team.

We are looking for a highly competent, reliable, and proactive team member who can manage incoming leads, communicate with potential sellers, and help close purchasing opportunities on a full-time, daily basis.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with leads, managing a CRM pipeline, communicating with customers, and working toward measurable performance goals.

You will be expected to work independently, follow established processes, and use good judgment when handling leads and purchasing opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

Lead Management & Purchasing

• Manage incoming leads and respond promptly to potential sellers.

• Communicate with leads through the company's primary communication and CRM system.

• Qualify leads by gathering the necessary information about potential purchases.

• Follow up consistently with leads and help move qualified opportunities toward a purchase.

• Negotiate and communicate professionally with sellers based on established purchasing guidelines.

• Identify worthwhile purchasing opportunities and help close qualified leads.

• Keep the lead pipeline organized and up to date.



CRM & Pipeline Management

• Manage and maintain the daily pipeline of leads within the CRM (GoHigh Level).

• Update lead statuses, notes, follow-ups, and other relevant information accurately.

• Make sure no qualified lead is overlooked or left without follow-up.

• Track lead activity and provide accurate updates on pipeline progress.



Customer Service & Communication

• Respond to customer and seller inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

• Build positive relationships with potential sellers and customers.

• Handle questions, concerns, and basic customer service needs.

• Maintain natural and professional communication while following company processes and guidelines.



Page Management & Lead Engagement

• Assist with basic business page management.

• Respond to comments and inquiries on advertisements and business pages.

• Help ensure potential leads are directed into the appropriate purchasing process.

• Monitor page activity and flag important questions, issues, or opportunities.



Product Sourcing

• Research and identify potential purchasing opportunities based on the company's criteria.

• Monitor relevant online marketplaces and other sources for potential deals.

• Gather information needed to evaluate potential purchases.

• Communicate promising opportunities to the appropriate team member when necessary.



Metrics & Reporting

• Track and report key daily and weekly performance metrics.

• Maintain accurate records of lead activity, follow-ups, conversions, and purchasing opportunities.

• Work in an environment where performance and measurable results are important.

• Use performance data to identify areas for improvement.



Requirements

• Previous experience in virtual assistance, customer service, sales, lead generation, purchasing, or a similar role is preferred.

• Experience working with a CRM or lead management system is strongly preferred.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Highly responsive, reliable, and consistent during working hours.

• Comfortable communicating with customers and potential sellers throughout the day.

• Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

• Able to manage a high volume of leads without losing track of details.

• Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Comfortable working with performance metrics and daily targets.

• Good judgment when evaluating leads and potential purchasing opportunities.

• Reliable internet connection and computer.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed.

• Experience with diabetic supplies, medical supplies, reselling, or other buyback businesses is a plus.



Schedule & Compensation

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Standard Time

Paid Hours: 8 hours per day

Rate: $5/hour

Monthly Compensation: Approximately $800/month

Employment Type: Full-Time

Position: Long-Term Opportunity



Benefits & Growth

• 2 weeks of paid time off, 1 week of paid sick leave, accessible in full once the VA begins working independently

• Room for compensation growth based on performance, reliability, and business growth

• Long-term opportunity within a growing Purchasing Agent team



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business and take on greater responsibility over time.



Apply here:

Application Form -

Please apply through the appropriate application link/form only to avoid duplicate applications. Not on the website, not on WhatsApp.

title: AI Engineering Lead (Profit Sharing Included)
description:
You'd be the first technical leader on our Philippines team. You'll help shape the architecture, set the engineering standards, and hire and lead the AI consultants who join after you. You'll work directly with our founder, and your decisions will matter from week one.



About The Alora Group



We're an AI implementation firm based in Jacksonville, Florida. We build AI systems for businesses that run on trucks, docks, job sites, and factory floors, including 3PLs, freight operators, manufacturers, and engineering firms. We have active client builds right now, and our founder has spent years delivering AI for enterprise companies before starting Alora.



We're also a faith-driven company. Part of our revenue goes to helping young people affected by fatherlessness and the juvenile justice system build real careers.



How We Think About AI and Engineering



We use AI to write code every day, and we expect you to as well. We don't believe AI replaces engineers. We believe it lets good engineers move much faster, as long as the foundations are taken seriously. Generated code still has to be debugged, refactored, scaled, and maintained by someone who understands it. That person is you.



The Problems You'll Solve



Our clients' data lives in legacy warehouse, transportation, and dispatch systems that were never built to talk to AI. The people using our tools are dock workers, drivers, and field inspectors who will never learn new software, so the systems have to work over
, SMS, and voice. Clients pay fixed prices, so LLM costs and reliability have to be predictable.



Current work includes an AI agent that reads broker
s and books dock appointments through a warehouse system's API, a voice-to-report app for civil engineering inspectors, and a production management platform for a boat manufacturer.



What You'll Own



Designing system architecture and long-term data models that won't need to be rebuilt in six months.

Building AI agents and automations on the Claude and OpenAI APIs, connected to real client systems.

Making products hold up under real user load and the edge cases that show up after launch.

Debugging, refactoring, and maintaining systems in production, including code that AI helped write.

Turning discovery notes into technical specs, estimates, and build plans.

Hiring, leading, and reviewing the work of our AI consultant team as it grows.



What You Bring



At least 2 years leading developers or technical teams.

Strong Python and/or TypeScript.

Production experience with the Claude API and/or OpenAI API, including tool use, structured outputs, and RAG.

A track record of designing databases and data models that lasted. We work in Postgres and Supabase.

Experience integrating third-party APIs, webhooks, and auth.

Experience scaling a product past its first version, including performance, failure handling, and monitoring.

Clear written and spoken English. You'll explain technical tradeoffs to US business owners.



Nice to have: agent frameworks, MCP, Claude Code, n8n, and any background in logistics, manufacturing, or field-service software.

title: Lead Generation and Outbound Sales Specialist (Part-Time, AU SaaS Client)
description:
Have you ever run someone else's outreach process and thought, "I could design this better myself"? This role gives you the chance to do exactly that — with a founder who genuinely wants your ideas.

An Australian SaaS founder is making his first-ever sales hire, and he's looking for a partner, not just a pair of hands. There's no existing pipeline or playbook — you'll help create it from the ground up, working directly with him, and then run it your way. He'll support you closely in the early weeks, then give you real room to work.





Why You'll Enjoy This Role

Your ideas shape everything. Targeting, cadence, qualification criteria, CRM workflow — you'll help design all of it. The founder sets the goal and trusts you with the how.

Your input is genuinely valued. The CRM is currently Pipedrive, but if you believe Go High Level (or something else) works better, he'll honestly consider switching. He wants your expertise, not just your output.

You work directly with the founder. No layers of management, no coordinators in between — just you and the person who built the product.

You're trusted, not tracked. Success is measured by qualified meetings on the calendar, not hours logged or activity screenshots.

The product is genuinely easy to get behind. It's a digital signature and document management platform with a real point of difference: documents are verified on a blockchain ledger, so there's absolute proof nothing was ever altered — and it costs less than DocuSign. Prospects actually want to hear about it.

There's a clear path forward. If the first three months go well, the role converts to full-time with a bigger scope.

You won't be thrown in the deep end. Week one is structured onboarding: a dedicated product login and real one-on-one time with the founder so you can talk about the product with confidence before any outreach begins.



The package:

Part-time: Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane) — around 20 hours/week, with afternoons and Fridays free

PHP 21,250/month + PHP 750/month benefits

LinkedIn Sales Navigator access provided



What Your Days Will Look Like

Finding the right people: identifying and qualifying SME decision-makers (C-suite, directors, owners) in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, and lending/debt collection

Running LinkedIn outreach: connection requests, outreach sequences, and follow-up messaging

Writing messages that get replies: drafting and refining based on response rates — the founder reviews message content before it goes out (so you're never guessing alone), while targeting and process are yours to own

Keeping the pipeline tidy: maintaining the CRM — lead records, conversation status, next steps, and flagging leads that have gone cold

Booking meetings: scheduling 15-minute discovery calls and 30-minute product demos into the founder's calendar — he runs the calls, you fill the diary

Shaping the system together: in your first two to four weeks, you and the founder will agree on what a qualified lead looks like, the outreach cadence, and the CRM workflow

Quick daily updates: a brief summary via Microsoft Teams so he always knows where things stand — no long reports, no micromanagement



You're a Great Fit If You Have

Hands-on LinkedIn outreach experience — you've run real campaigns before and can comfortably chat about what you sent, what the response rates were, and what you adjusted along the way. (We love hearing about the experiments that didn't work too — that's how we know you've really done this.)

Confidence building a process from scratch — you enjoy figuring out what works rather than following a fixed script

A self-directed working style — you're happy planning your own days, keeping track of your own progress, and raising things early rather than waiting to be asked

Strong written English — your messages will be the first impression prospects get, so clear, polished writing matters here

Good CRM habits — you know how to structure a pipeline so it actually tells a story, not just store data

An easy-going nature — the founder is friendly, casual, and direct. He says what he means, appreciates people who can take a joke, and cares about results rather than formality. If you like working without pretence, you'll get along well.



Bonus Points (Nice but Not Required)

Go High Level experience

LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience

Background in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, or lending and debt collection

B2B SaaS outreach experience

Experience positioning a product against a big-name competitor like DocuSign



Don't have the bonuses? Apply anyway — the essentials above are what matter.





One Honest Note

Because there's no existing playbook, this role suits someone who finds a blank page exciting rather than stressful. If you prefer a clearly defined process handed to you on day one, you'd likely find this one frustrating — and we'd rather you find a role you'll love. But if "here's the goal, show us what works" sounds like freedom rather than pressure, you'll thrive here.





Schedule

Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Product / UI Designer – Link-in-Bio & Creator Storefront



About the Project



We are building a new link-in-bio and creator storefront experience that helps creators showcase their content, recommendations, products, links, and partnerships in one place.



We are looking for a talented Product / UI Designer to help design the creator-facing experience and establish the visual direction for the product.



This is not simply a landing-page design project. We need someone who can think through how creators customize and use their page while keeping the experience clean, premium, mobile-first, and conversion-focused.



What You'll Design



The initial project will focus on the public-facing creator page, including:



Creator profile and header



Social media links



Featured links and CTAs



Product recommendation cards



Shoppable/storefront sections



Featured content and video



Multiple page layouts and themes



Mobile-first responsive design



Different content and profile states



We also want to explore a flexible template and customization system that gives creators control over the look and feel of their page without making the experience cluttered or inconsistent.



Design Direction



We want the experience to feel:



Modern. Creator-first. Premium. Visual. Simple. Commerce-driven.



Think of the intersection between a modern social profile, link-in-bio page, and creator storefront — but with its own distinct visual identity.



The experience should encourage visitors to discover, click, shop, and engage while still feeling authentic to the creator.



Key Design Challenge



One of the biggest challenges is balancing creator customization with design consistency.



Creators should have enough flexibility to personalize their pages through themes, imagery, colors, layouts, and content modules while the overall product maintains a polished and consistent experience.



We want a designer who can help us think through this system rather than simply design individual screens.



Initial Deliverables



We are looking for:



2–3 initial visual concepts/directions



Primary mobile link-in-bio page



Desktop/responsive version



Creator profile/header components



Link and CTA components



Product/storefront cards



Content and video modules



Theme/customization concepts



Examples showing how different types of creators could customize their pages



Reusable component/design system



Developer-ready Figma files

title: Technical Sourcing & Operations Assistant – Engineering Background Preferred
description:
# Technical Sourcing & Operations Assistant – Engineering Background Preferred



We are a U.S.-based industrial distributor specializing in cutting tools, workholding, abrasives, measuring tools, and other supplies for CNC machine shops and manufacturers.



We are looking for a **smart, technically minded person who enjoys researching products, solving problems, learning new systems, and figuring things out independently.**



**This is NOT a typical data-entry virtual assistant position.** We are looking for someone who can think through technical problems, research solutions, learn our industry, and eventually become an important part of our sales and operations team.



The position will start at approximately **20 hours per week** and is expected to grow to **full-time (40 hours/week) within 1–3 months** for the right person based on performance and workload.



**Compensation: $8–$12 USD/hour depending on experience, technical ability, and communication skills.**



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



### Technical Product Research & Sourcing



Our customers frequently contact us describing a cutting tool, industrial product, or machining application they need help with.



You will research these requests and help identify appropriate products and solutions.



Responsibilities include:



- Research cutting tools and industrial products from multiple manufacturers

- Identify products that meet customer requirements

- Find alternatives for discontinued, unavailable, or expensive products

- Compare dimensions, specifications, materials, coatings, and applications

- Cross-reference products between manufacturers

- Locate exact manufacturer part numbers and technical documentation

- Research supplier availability and pricing

- Prepare organized product recommendations

- Assist with customer RFQs and quote preparation

- Help draft responses to customer technical and product questions



You are **not expected to already be a machining or cutting-tool expert**. We will train the right person.



However, you must enjoy technical research, be comfortable working with specifications and dimensions, and have the ability to investigate unfamiliar problems rather than simply waiting for someone to give you the answer.



### ERP, Database & Order Support



You will eventually be trained on our **Epicor Prophet 21 ERP system** and other internal systems.



Responsibilities may include:



- Creating and maintaining product records

- Maintaining manufacturer and supplier information

- Creating accurate product descriptions and specifications

- Pricing and cost updates

- Spreadsheet imports and exports

- Database cleanup and organization

- Quote preparation

- Order entry and processing

- Purchase-order and supplier follow-up

- Helping maintain accurate inventory and product information



Prior Prophet 21 experience is **NOT required**.



Experience with another ERP, inventory, database, or order-management system is helpful.



### Website & eBay



You will help maintain our company website, large online product catalog, and eBay presence.



Responsibilities may include:



- Creating and updating product listings

- Maintaining product specifications and descriptions

- Organizing product images and manufacturer information

- Researching and correcting product-data issues

- Managing eBay listings

- Helping improve the accuracy and quality of our online product database

- Researching manufacturer information needed for new products

- Identifying and correcting incomplete or inaccurate product records



### Industrial Vending Systems



We operate industrial vending systems for customers. You will eventually learn to assist with systems including **Matrix and WebVend**.



Responsibilities may include:



- Product setup

- User administration

- Inventory data

- Reporting

- Customer account maintenance

- Product and inventory updates

- Basic troubleshooting and support



Prior experience with these systems is **NOT required**.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A background in **Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Technology, or another technical discipline is strongly preferred.**



A degree is preferred but not required if you can demonstrate strong technical problem-solving ability.



We care more about your ability to **research, learn, think, and solve problems accurately** than whether you already know our industry.



You should have:



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Excellent internet research skills

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills

- High attention to detail

- Strong general computer skills

- Ability to understand dimensions and technical specifications

- Ability to compare technical products and identify important differences

- Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly

- Strong organizational skills

- Ability to work independently

- Willingness to investigate a problem before asking for help

- Good judgment about when you are uncertain and need assistance

- Genuine curiosity and desire to learn

- Reliable computer and internet connection



Experience with any of the following is helpful but **NOT required**:



- CNC machining

- Cutting tools

- Manufacturing

- Mechanical or industrial engineering

- Industrial distribution

- Technical sales

- ERP systems

- Product databases

- Inventory management

- eBay or ecommerce

- Website product management



## WORK SCHEDULE – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



This position requires working during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



Because this position supports our sales and operations team in real time, you must be comfortable working a **night-shift schedule in the Philippines on a long-term basis**.



The position will initially be approximately:



**20 hours per week**  

**Approximately 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday, during U.S. Pacific Time business hours**



For a successful candidate, we expect the position to grow to approximately:



**40 hours per week within 1–3 months**  

**Approximately 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday, during U.S. Pacific Time business hours**



The exact working hours can be discussed with the selected candidate, but **working during our U.S. business day is a requirement of this position.**



We are looking for someone interested in a **long-term position**, not a temporary freelance project.



## COMPENSATION



**$8–$12 USD per hour**, depending on:



- Experience

- Technical aptitude

- Research ability

- English communication

- Computer skills

- Problem-solving ability



We are willing to pay toward the upper end of the range for an exceptional candidate.



## HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word:



**CARBIDE**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.



Please provide the following:



1. Your resume and educational background.



2. Your current employment situation and availability.



3. Your desired hourly rate in USD.



4. **This position requires working U.S. Pacific Time business hours, which will generally be overnight hours in the Philippines. Are you able and willing to work this schedule on a long-term basis? Please state the exact Pacific Time hours you are available Monday through Friday.**



5. **Do you currently have another job or ongoing clients? If yes, describe your normal work schedule and approximate weekly commitments.**



6. Your computer specifications and operating system.



7. Your internet connection type and internet speed.



8. **Do you have backup internet access in case your primary internet connection fails?**



9. **Do you have backup power available in case of a power outage? If so, briefly describe it.**



10. Briefly explain why this type of technical problem-solving position interests you.



## TECHNICAL RESEARCH EXERCISE



A customer contacts us and says:



**“I need a 3/8-inch solid-carbide end mill for machining stainless steel. I would prefer 5 flutes.”**



Find **three appropriate options from three different manufacturers**.



For each option provide:



- Manufacturer

- Exact manufacturer part number

- Product description

- Number of flutes

- Relevant dimensions

- Manufacturer product page or catalog link

- Why you believe the tool is appropriate for machining stainless steel



**Important: If you cannot verify something, clearly state that you cannot verify it rather than guessing or inventing information.**



Accuracy is more important than providing an answer to every field.



## PROBLEM-SOLVING QUESTION #1



A customer provides a manufacturer's part number.



You research it and discover that the product has been discontinued and is no longer available.



Explain **step-by-step** how you would research and identify the best replacement.



We are interested in understanding your thought process, not just your final answer.



## PROBLEM-SOLVING QUESTION #2



Tell us about a technical problem you had to solve where you initially did not know the answer.



Please explain:



- What the problem was

- What you initially knew and did not know

- How you researched or investigated it

- How you determined the answer

- What the final result was



## WHAT WE VALUE



We value:



**Accuracy. Resourcefulness. Curiosity. Organization. Good judgment. Technical aptitude.**



We do not expect you to know everything.



We **do** expect you to know how to research something you don't know, distinguish verified information from assumptions, ask good questions, and continue learning.



For the right person, our goal is for this position to grow beyond an assistant role and become an important long-term technical and operations position within our company.
